WITH src AS (
    SELECT
        id AS patient_id,
        resource
    FROM {{ source('raw_fhir_r4', 'patient') }}
),

parsed AS (
    SELECT
        patient_id,
        CAST(json_extract_string(resource, '$.birthDate') AS DATE) AS birth_date,
        CAST(json_extract_string(resource, '$.deceasedDateTime') AS DATE) AS death_date,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.identifier[?(@.type.coding[0].code=="SS")].value') AS ssn,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.identifier[?(@.type.coding[0].code=="DL")].value') AS drivers_license_number,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.identifier[?(@.type.coding[0].code=="PPN")].value') AS passport_number,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.name[0].prefix[0]') AS patient_prefix,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.name[0].given[0]') AS patient_first_name,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.name[0].family') AS patient_last_name,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.name[0].suffix[0]') AS patient_suffix,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.name[?(@.use=="maiden")].family') AS maiden_name,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.maritalStatus.coding[0].code') AS marital_status,
        COALESCE(
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.extension[?(@.url=="http://hl7.org/fhir/us/core/StructureDefinition/us-core-race")].extension[?(@.url=="text")].valueString'),
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.extension[?(@.url=="http://hl7.org/fhir/us/core/StructureDefinition/us-core-race")].extension[?(@.url=="ombCategory")].valueCoding.display')
        ) AS race,
        COALESCE(
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.extension[?(@.url=="http://hl7.org/fhir/us/core/StructureDefinition/us-core-ethnicity")].extension[?(@.url=="text")].valueString'),
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.extension[?(@.url=="http://hl7.org/fhir/us/core/StructureDefinition/us-core-ethnicity")].extension[?(@.url=="ombCategory")].valueCoding.display')
        ) AS ethnicity,
        CASE
            WHEN LOWER(json_extract_string(resource, '$.gender')) = 'male' THEN 'M'
            WHEN LOWER(json_extract_string(resource, '$.gender')) = 'female' THEN 'F'
            ELSE NULL
        END AS patient_gender,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.extension[?(@.url=="http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/patient-birthPlace")].valueAddress.city') AS birthplace,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.address[0].line[0]') AS patient_address,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.address[0].city') AS patient_city,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.address[0].state') AS patient_state_abbr,
        NULL AS patient_county,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.address[0].postalCode') AS patient_zip,
        CAST(json_extract_string(resource, '$.address[0].extension[?(@.url=="http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/geolocation")].extension[?(@.url=="latitude")].valueDecimal') AS DOUBLE) AS patient_latitude,
        CAST(json_extract_string(resource, '$.address[0].extension[?(@.url=="http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/geolocation")].extension[?(@.url=="longitude")].valueDecimal') AS DOUBLE) AS patient_longitude,
        NULL::DOUBLE AS healthcare_expenses,
        NULL::DOUBLE AS healthcare_coverage
    FROM src
)

SELECT
    patient_id,
    birth_date,
    death_date,
    ssn,
    drivers_license_number,
    passport_number,
    patient_prefix,
    patient_first_name,
    patient_last_name,
    patient_suffix,
    maiden_name,
    marital_status,
    race,
    ethnicity,
    patient_gender,
    birthplace,
    patient_address,
    patient_city,
    COALESCE(state_map.state_name, parsed.patient_state_abbr) AS patient_state,
    patient_county,
    patient_zip,
    patient_latitude,
    patient_longitude,
    healthcare_expenses,
    healthcare_coverage
FROM parsed
LEFT JOIN {{ ref('stg_map__states') }} AS state_map
       ON state_map.state_abbreviation = parsed.patient_state_abbr

                THEN SPLIT_PART(JSON_EXTRACT_STRING(resource, '$.deceasedDateTime'), 'T', 1)
                ELSE NULL
            END AS DATE
        )                                                                                     AS death_date,

        -- identifiers
        (SELECT value FROM UNNEST(JSON_EXTRACT(resource, '$.identifier')) AS i
         WHERE JSON_EXTRACT_STRING(i, '$.system') = 'http://hl7.org/fhir/sid/us-ssn'
               AND JSON_EXTRACT_STRING(i, '$.type.coding[0].code') = 'SS')                    AS ssn,
        (SELECT value FROM UNNEST(JSON_EXTRACT(resource, '$.identifier')) AS i
         WHERE JSON_EXTRACT_STRING(i, '$.type.coding[0].code') = 'DL')                        AS drivers_license_number,
        (SELECT value FROM UNNEST(JSON_EXTRACT(resource, '$.identifier')) AS i
         WHERE JSON_EXTRACT_STRING(i, '$.type.coding[0].code') = 'PPN')                       AS passport_number,

        -- name components (official name)
        JSON_EXTRACT_STRING(resource, '$.name[0].prefix[0]')                                   AS patient_prefix,
        JSON_EXTRACT_STRING(resource, '$.name[0].given[0]')                                    AS patient_first_name,
        JSON_EXTRACT_STRING(resource, '$.name[0].family')                                      AS patient_last_name,
        JSON_EXTRACT_STRING(resource, '$.name[0].suffix[0]')                                   AS patient_suffix,

        -- maiden name (use = maiden)
        (SELECT JSON_EXTRACT_STRING(n, '$.family')
         FROM UNNEST(JSON_EXTRACT(resource, '$.name')) AS n

         LIMIT 1)                                                                              AS maiden_name,

        JSON_EXTRACT_STRING(resource, '$.maritalStatus.coding[0].code')                       AS marital_status,

        JSON_EXTRACT_STRING(resource, '$.extension[0].extension[1].valueString')             AS race,
        JSON_EXTRACT_STRING(resource, '$.extension[1].extension[1].valueString')             AS ethnicity,

        -- gender to single‑letter code
        CASE LOWER(JSON_EXTRACT_STRING(resource, '$.gender'))

            WHEN 'female' THEN 'F'
            ELSE UPPER(JSON_EXTRACT_STRING(resource, '$.gender'))

        NULL::DOUBLE                                                                           AS healthcare_expenses,

with raw as (

    select
        -- basic identifiers
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.id') as encounter_id,

        -- timestamps
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.period.start') as period_start,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.period.end')   as period_end,

        -- references
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.subject.reference')          as patient_ref,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.serviceProvider.reference') as org_ref,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.participant[0].individual.reference') as provider_ref,

        -- classification and type
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.class.code')                as encounter_class,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.type[0].coding[0].code')    as encounter_code,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.type[0].coding[0].display') as encounter_description,

        -- reason
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.reasonCode[0].coding[0].code')    as reason_code,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.reasonCode[0].coding[0].display') as reason_desc

    from {{ source('raw_fhir_r4', 'encounter') }}
),

transformed as (

    select
        encounter_id,

        -- convert to TIMESTAMP (DuckDB parses ISO‑8601 with offset to UTC)
        cast(period_start as timestamp) as encounter_start_datetime,
        cast(coalesce(period_end, period_start) as timestamp) as encounter_stop_datetime,

        -- dates derived from timestamps
        cast(period_start as date) as encounter_start_date,
        cast(coalesce(period_end, period_start) as date) as encounter_stop_date,

        -- patient identifier (strip the "urn:uuid:" prefix)
        regexp_replace(patient_ref, '^urn:uuid:', '') as patient_id,

        -- organization identifier (extract part after the pipe, if present)
        case
            when org_ref is null then null
            when position('|' in org_ref) > 0 then split_part(org_ref, '|', 2)
            else null
        end as organization_id,

        -- provider identifier (extract part after the pipe, if present)
        case
            when provider_ref is null then null
            when position('|' in provider_ref) > 0 then split_part(provider_ref, '|', 2)
            else null
        end as provider_id,

        -- payer is not present in the FHIR resource
        null::varchar as payer_id,

        encounter_code,
        encounter_description,

        -- cost fields are not supplied in the source
        null::double as base_encounter_cost,
        null::double as total_encounter_cost,
        null::double as encounter_payer_coverage,

        reason_desc as encounter_reason_description

    from raw
)

    SELECT
        resource
    FROM {{ source('raw_fhir_r4', 'encounter') }}
),

    SELECT
        -- identifiers
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.id') AS encounter_id,

        -- timestamps (naive UTC)
        CAST(json_extract_string(resource, '$.period.start') AS TIMESTAMP) AS encounter_start_datetime,
        CAST(
            COALESCE(
                json_extract_string(resource, '$.period.end'),
                json_extract_string(resource, '$.period.start')
            ) AS TIMESTAMP
        ) AS encounter_stop_datetime,

        -- dates derived from timestamps
        CAST(json_extract_string(resource, '$.period.start') AS DATE) AS encounter_start_date,
        CAST(
            COALESCE(
                json_extract_string(resource, '$.period.end'),
                json_extract_string(resource, '$.period.start')
            ) AS DATE
        ) AS encounter_stop_date,

        -- foreign keys
        REGEXP_REPLACE(
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.subject.reference'),
            '^urn:uuid:',
            ''
        ) AS patient_id,

        REGEXP_REPLACE(
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.serviceProvider.reference'),
            '.*\\|',
            ''
        ) AS organization_id,

        REGEXP_REPLACE(
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.participant[0].individual.reference'),
            '.*\\|',
            ''
        ) AS provider_id,

        NULL::VARCHAR AS payer_id,

        -- encounter attributes
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.class.code') AS encounter_class,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.type[0].coding[0].code') AS encounter_code,
        COALESCE(
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.type[0].coding[0].display'),
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.type[0].text')

with
raw_conditions as (
    select
        resource
    from {{ source('raw_fhir_r4', 'condition') }}
),

extracted as (
    select
        -- start date: onsetDateTime (date part only, cast to DATE)
        cast(substr(json_extract_string(resource, '$.onsetDateTime'), 1, 10) as date) as condition_start_date,

        -- stop date: abatementDateTime if present, otherwise NULL
        case
            when json_extract_string(resource, '$.abatementDateTime') is not null
            then cast(substr(json_extract_string(resource, '$.abatementDateTime'), 1, 10) as date)
        end as condition_stop_date,

        -- patient identifier (strip leading "urn:uuid:")
        regexp_replace(
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.subject.reference'),
            '^urn:uuid:',
            ''
        ) as patient_id,

        -- encounter identifier (strip leading "urn:uuid:")
        regexp_replace(
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.encounter.reference'),
            '^urn:uuid:',
            ''
        ) as encounter_id,

        -- condition code (first coding entry)
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.code.coding[0].code') as condition_code,

        -- condition description: prefer coding display, fall back to code.text
        coalesce(
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.code.coding[0].display'),
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.code.text')
        ) as condition_description
    from raw_conditions
)

from extracted

            ORDER BY CAST(i.key AS INTEGER)
            LIMIT 1

            SELECT i.value ->> 'value'
            FROM json_each(p.resource, '$.identifier') AS i
            WHERE EXISTS (
                SELECT 1
                FROM json_each(i.value, '$.type.coding') AS c
                WHERE c.value ->> 'code' = 'DL'
            )
            ORDER BY CAST(i.key AS INTEGER)
            LIMIT 1
        ) AS drivers_license_number,
        (
            SELECT i.value ->> 'value'
            FROM json_each(p.resource, '$.identifier') AS i
            WHERE i.value ->> 'system'

               OR EXISTS (
                    SELECT 1
                    FROM json_each(i.value, '$.type.coding') AS c
                    WHERE c.value ->> 'code' = 'PPN'
               )
            ORDER BY CAST(i.key AS INTEGER)
            LIMIT 1
        ) AS passport_number,
        (
            SELECT n.value
            FROM json_each(p.resource, '$.name') AS n
            WHERE COALESCE(n.value ->> 'use', '') NOT IN ('maiden', 'old')
            ORDER BY
                CASE WHEN n.value ->> 'use' = 'official' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,
                CAST(n.key AS INTEGER)
            LIMIT 1
        ) AS patient_name,
        (
            SELECT n.value ->> 'family'
            FROM json_each(p.resource, '$.name') AS n
            WHERE n.value ->> 'use' = 'maiden'
            ORDER BY CAST(n.key AS INTEGER)
            LIMIT 1
        ) AS maiden_name,
        (
            SELECT a.value
            FROM json_each(p.resource, '$.address') AS a
            ORDER BY
                CASE
                    WHEN a.value ->> 'use' = 'home' THEN 0
                    WHEN a.value ->> 'use' = 'old' THEN 2

            WHERE e.value ->> 'url' = 'latitude'

    -- stg_acq__encounters
    -- Transform raw FHIR Encounter JSON into the staging contract

WITH src AS (
    SELECT
        resource
    FROM {{ source('raw_fhir_r4', 'encounter') }}
),

cte AS (
    SELECT
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.id') AS encounter_id,

        -- start datetime (assumed UTC)
        CAST(json_extract_string(resource, '$.period.start') AS TIMESTAMP) AS encounter_start_datetime,

        -- raw stop datetime (may be null)
        CAST(json_extract_string(resource, '$.period.end') AS TIMESTAMP) AS raw_encounter_stop_datetime,

        -- patient reference: "urn:uuid:<uuid>"
        REPLACE(
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.subject.reference'),
            'urn:uuid:',
            ''
        ) AS patient_id,

        -- organization reference: "...|<org_id>"
        REGEXP_EXTRACT(
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.serviceProvider.reference'),
            '\\|([^|]+)$',
            1
        ) AS organization_id,

        -- provider reference: first participant's individual reference "...|<prov_id>"
        REGEXP_EXTRACT(
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.participant[0].individual.reference'),
            '\\|([^|]+)$',
            1
        ) AS provider_id,

        -- encounter class code (e.g., "AMB")

{{-
    -- stg_acq__encounters
    -- Transform raw FHIR Encounter JSON into the staging contract
-}}
WITH src AS (
    SELECT
        resource
    FROM {{ source('raw_fhir_r4', 'encounter') }}
),

cte AS (
    SELECT
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.id') AS encounter_id,

        -- start datetime (assumed UTC)
        CAST(json_extract_string(resource, '$.period.start') AS TIMESTAMP) AS encounter_start_datetime,

        -- raw stop datetime (may be null)
        CAST(json_extract_string(resource, '$.period.end') AS TIMESTAMP) AS raw_encounter_stop_datetime,

        -- patient reference: "urn:uuid:<uuid>"
        REPLACE(
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.subject.reference'),
            'urn:uuid:',
            ''
        ) AS patient_id,

        -- organization reference: "...|<org_id>"
        REGEXP_EXTRACT(
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.serviceProvider.reference'),
            '\\|([^|]+)$',
            1
        ) AS organization_id,

        -- provider reference: first participant's individual reference "...|<prov_id>"
        REGEXP_EXTRACT(
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.participant[0].individual.reference'),
            '\\|([^|]+)$',
            1
        ) AS provider_id,

        -- encounter class code (e.g., "AMB")
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.class.code') AS encounter_class,

        -- primary encounter type code and description
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.type[0].coding[0].code') AS encounter_code,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.type[0].coding[0].display') AS encounter_description,

        -- reason (optional)
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.reasonCode[0].coding[0].code') AS encounter_reason_code,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.reasonCode[0].coding[0].display') AS encounter_reason_description
    FROM src
)

Maps raw FHIR R4 Encounter resources into the acquirer’s staging contract.

with

raw_enc as (
    select
        id as encounter_id,
        resource
    from {{ source('raw_fhir_r4', 'encounter') }}
),

-- extract primitive fields from the JSON payload
extracted as (
    select
        encounter_id,

        -- patient reference without the urn:uuid: prefix
        regexp_replace(
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.subject.reference'),
            '^urn:uuid:',
            ''
        ) as patient_id,

        -- period start / end timestamps (ISO8601 with offset)
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.period.start')          as start_iso,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.period.end')            as end_iso,

        -- class code (e.g., AMB, EMER, IMP)
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.class.code')           as class_code,

        -- encounter type coding (first element)
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.type[0].coding[0].code')   as type_code,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.type[0].coding[0].display') as type_display,

        -- reason code / description (may be null)
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.reasonCode[0].coding[0].code')   as reason_code,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.reasonCode[0].coding[0].display') as reason_display,

        -- service provider reference (contains org id after a '|')
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.serviceProvider.reference') as service_provider_ref,

        -- primary participant display (contains provider name prefixed with "Dr. ")
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.participant[0].individual.display') as participant_display
    from raw_enc
),

-- resolve organization_id and provider_id
joined as (
    select
        e.*,

        -- organization_id: text after the final pipe character
        regexp_extract(e.service_provider_ref, '\\|([^|]+)$', 1) as organization_id,

        -- provider name without leading "Dr. " (trim whitespace)
        trim(regexp_replace(e.participant_display, '^Dr\\.\\s*', '')) as provider_name
    from extracted e
),

-- lookup provider_id using name + organization match
provider_lookup as (
    select
        p.Id as provider_id,
        lower(p.NAME) as provider_name_lc,
        p.ORGANIZATION as organization_id
    from {{ source('raw_fhir_r4', 'providers') }} p
),

-- bring everything together and compute derived columns
final as (
    select
        j.encounter_id,

        -- timestamps converted to UTC (DuckDB to_timestamp handles the offset)
        to_timestamp(j.start_iso, '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S%z') as encounter_start_datetime,
        to_timestamp(coalesce(j.end_iso, j.start_iso), '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S%z') as encounter_stop_datetime,

        -- dates (date part of timestamps)
        cast(to_timestamp(j.start_iso, '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S%z') as date) as encounter_start_date,
        cast(to_timestamp(coalesce(j.end_iso, j.start_iso), '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S%z') as date) as encounter_stop_date,

        j.patient_id,
        j.organization_id,

        -- provider_id via name + organization join; if not found, return NULL
        prov.provider_id,

        -- payer information not present in FHIR; set NULL
        cast(null as varchar) as payer_id,

        -- encounter class mapping
        case
            when j.class_code = 'EMER' then 'emergency'
            when j.class_code = 'IMP'  then 'inpatient'
            when j.class_code = 'AMB' then
                case
                    when j.type_code in ('702927004') then 'urgentcare'
                    when j.type_code in ('162673000', '410620009', '308646001') then 'wellness'
                    else 'ambulatory'
                end
            else null
        end as encounter_class,

        -- code & description (commas replaced by spaces)
        replace(coalesce(j.type_code, ''), ',', ' ') as encounter_code,
        replace(coalesce(j.type_display, ''), ',', ' ') as encounter_description,

        -- cost columns – not available, return NULL
        cast(null as double) as base_encounter_cost,
        cast(null as double) as total_encounter_cost,
        cast(null as double) as encounter_payer_coverage,

        -- reason code / description (commas replaced by spaces)
        replace(coalesce(j.reason_code, ''), ',', ' ') as encounter_reason_code,
        replace(coalesce(j.reason_display, ''), ',', ' ') as encounter_reason_description

    from joined j
    left join provider_lookup prov
        on lower(j.provider_name) = prov.provider_name_lc
        and j.organization_id = prov.organization_id
)

select *
from final

with
raw_enc as (
    select
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.id') as encounter_id,
        cast(json_extract_string(resource, '$.period.start') as timestamp) as encounter_start_datetime,
        cast(coalesce(
                json_extract_string(resource, '$.period.end'),
                json_extract_string(resource, '$.period.start')
            ) as timestamp) as encounter_stop_datetime,
        -- patient id without the urn:uuid: prefix
        replace(json_extract_string(resource, '$.subject.reference'), 'urn:uuid:', '') as patient_id,
        -- organization id is the part after the pipe in serviceProvider.reference
        regexp_extract(json_extract_string(resource, '$.serviceProvider.reference'), '\\|(.*)$', 1) as organization_id,
        -- raw class code (e.g., AMB, EMER, IMP)
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.class.code') as class_code_raw,
        -- first type coding code and display (used for class mapping, code & description)
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.type[0].coding[0].code') as type_code_raw,
        coalesce(
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.type[0].coding[0].display'),
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.type[0].text')
        ) as encounter_description_raw,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.type[0].coding[0].code') as encounter_code_raw,
        -- reason (may be null)
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.reasonCode[0].coding[0].code') as encounter_reason_code_raw,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.reasonCode[0].coding[0].display') as encounter_reason_description_raw,
        -- participant display (e.g., "Dr. John Doe") – strip leading “Dr.” and trim
        trim(regexp_replace(
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.participant[0].individual.display'),
            '^Dr\\.\\s*',
            ''
        )) as provider_display_clean
    from {{ source('raw_fhir_r4', 'encounter') }}

        , addr[1] AS a1
        , list_filter(ext, x -> json_extract_string(x, '$.url') LIKE '%us-core-race')[1] AS race_ext

        , list_filter(ext, x -> json_extract_string(x, '$.url') LIKE '%us-core-birthsex')[1] AS sex_ext
        , list_filter(ext, x -> json_extract_string(x, '$.url') LIKE '%patient-birthPlace')[1] AS bp_ext
    FROM src

)

, parts2 AS (

    SELECT
        p.*
        , list_filter(
            from_json(race_ext -> '$.extension', '["JSON"]')
            , y -> json_extract_string(y, '$.url') = 'ombCategory'
        )[1] AS race_omb
        , list_filter(
            from_json(eth_ext -> '$.extension', '["JSON"]')
            , y -> json_extract_string(y, '$.url') = 'ombCategory'
        )[1] AS eth_omb
        , list_filter(
            from_json(a1 -> '$.extension', '["JSON"]')
            , y -> json_extract_string(y, '$.url') LIKE '%geolocation'
        )[1] AS geo
    FROM parts AS p

)

, parts3 AS (

    SELECT
        p.*
        , json_extract_string(race_omb, '$.valueCoding.code') AS race_code
        , lower(coalesce(
            json_extract_string(race_omb, '$.valueCoding.display')
            , json_extract_string(
                list_filter(
                    from_json(race_ext -> '$.extension', '["JSON"]')
                    , y -> json_extract_string(y, '$.url') = 'text'
                )[1]
                , '$.valueString'
            )
        )) AS race_text
        , json_extract_string(eth_omb, '$.valueCoding.code') AS eth_code
        , lower(coalesce(
            json_extract_string(eth_omb, '$.valueCoding.display')
            , json_extract_string(

                    from_json(eth_ext -> '$.extension', '["JSON"]')
                    , y -> json_extract_string(y, '$.url') = 'text'
                )[1]
                , '$.valueString'

        , list_filter(

    FROM parts2 AS p

, shaped AS (

        lower(trim(regexp_replace(
            coalesce(json_extract_string(resource, '$.id'), source_id)
            , '^(urn:uuid:|Patient/)', ''
        ))) AS patient_id
        , try_cast(json_extract_string(resource, '$.birthDate') AS DATE) AS birth_date
        , CASE
            WHEN deceased_raw IS NULL OR trim(deceased_raw) = '' THEN NULL
            WHEN length(trim(deceased_raw)) = 10 THEN try_cast(trim(deceased_raw) AS DATE)
            ELSE CAST(timezone('UTC', try_cast(trim(deceased_raw) AS TIMESTAMPTZ)) AS DATE)
        END AS death_date
        , nullif(trim(json_extract_string(ssn_id, '$.value')), '') AS ssn
        , nullif(trim(json_extract_string(dl_id, '$.value')), '') AS drivers_license_number
        , nullif(trim(json_extract_string(ppn_id, '$.value')), '') AS passport_number

        , nullif(trim(json_extract_string(official_name, '$.family')), '') AS patient_last_name
        , nullif(trim(json_extract_string(official_name, '$.suffix[0]')), '') AS patient_suffix
        , nullif(trim(json_extract_string(maiden_nm, '$.family')), '') AS maiden_name
        , nullif(trim(coalesce(
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.maritalStatus.coding[0].code')
            , json_extract_string(resource, '$.maritalStatus.text')
        )), '') AS marital_status
        , CASE
            WHEN race_code = '2106-3' THEN 'white'
            WHEN race_code = '2054-5' THEN 'black'
            WHEN race_code = '2028-9' THEN 'asian'
            WHEN race_code = '1002-5' THEN 'native'
            WHEN race_code = '2076-8' THEN 'hawaiian'
            WHEN race_code IS NOT NULL THEN 'other'
            WHEN race_text = 'white' THEN 'white'
            WHEN race_text LIKE 'black%' THEN 'black'
            WHEN race_text = 'asian' THEN 'asian'
            WHEN race_text LIKE 'american indian%' THEN 'native'
            WHEN race_text LIKE 'native hawaiian%' THEN 'hawaiian'
            WHEN race_text IS NOT NULL THEN 'other'
        END AS race
        , CASE
            WHEN eth_code = '2135-2' THEN 'hispanic'
            WHEN eth_code = '2186-5' THEN 'nonhispanic'
            WHEN eth_text LIKE 'not hispanic%' THEN 'nonhispanic'
            WHEN eth_text LIKE 'hispanic%' THEN 'hispanic'
        END AS ethnicity
        , CASE
            WHEN lower(json_extract_string(resource, '$.gender')) = 'male' THEN 'M'
            WHEN lower(json_extract_string(resource, '$.gender')) = 'female' THEN 'F'
            WHEN upper(json_extract_string(sex_ext, '$.valueCode')) IN ('M', 'F')
                THEN upper(json_extract_string(sex_ext, '$.valueCode'))
        END AS patient_gender
        , nullif(concat_ws(
            '  '
            , nullif(json_extract_string(bp_ext, '$.valueAddress.city'), '')
            , nullif(json_extract_string(bp_ext, '$.valueAddress.state'), '')
            , nullif(json_extract_string(bp_ext, '$.valueAddress.country'), '')
        ), '') AS birthplace
        , nullif(trim(json_extract_string(a1, '$.line[0]')), '') AS patient_address
        , nullif(trim(json_extract_string(a1, '$.city')), '') AS patient_city
        , nullif(trim(json_extract_string(a1, '$.state')), '') AS state_raw
        , nullif(trim(json_extract_string(a1, '$.postalCode')), '') AS patient_zip
        , CAST(json_extract_string(lat_obj, '$.valueDecimal') AS FLOAT) AS patient_latitude
        , CAST(json_extract_string(lon_obj, '$.valueDecimal') AS FLOAT) AS patient_longitude
    FROM parts3

)

        , nullif(trim(json_extract_string(official_name, '$.family')), '') AS patient_last_name
        , nullif(trim(json_extract_string(official_name, '$.suffix[0]')), '') AS patient_suffix
        , nullif(trim(json_extract_string(maiden_nm, '$.family')), '') AS maiden_name
        , nullif(trim(coalesce(
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.maritalStatus.coding[0].code')
            , json_extract_string(resource, '$.maritalStatus.text')
        )), '') AS marital_status
        , CASE
            WHEN race_code = '2106-3' THEN 'white'
            WHEN race_code = '2054-5' THEN 'black'
            WHEN race_code = '2028-9' THEN 'asian'
            WHEN race_code = '1002-5' THEN 'native'
            WHEN race_code = '2076-8' THEN 'hawaiian'
            WHEN race_code IS NOT NULL THEN 'other'
            WHEN race_text = 'white' THEN 'white'
            WHEN race_text LIKE 'black%' THEN 'black'
            WHEN race_text = 'asian' THEN 'asian'
            WHEN race_text LIKE 'american indian%' THEN 'native'
            WHEN race_text LIKE 'native hawaiian%' THEN 'hawaiian'
            WHEN race_text IS NOT NULL THEN 'other'
        END AS race
        , CASE
            WHEN eth_code = '2135-2' THEN 'hispanic'
            WHEN eth_code = '2186-5' THEN 'nonhispanic'
            WHEN eth_text LIKE 'not hispanic%' THEN 'nonhispanic'
            WHEN eth_text LIKE 'hispanic%' THEN 'hispanic'
        END AS ethnicity
        , CASE
            WHEN lower(json_extract_string(resource, '$.gender')) = 'male' THEN 'M'
            WHEN lower(json_extract_string(resource, '$.gender')) = 'female' THEN 'F'
            WHEN upper(json_extract_string(sex_ext, '$.valueCode')) IN ('M', 'F')
                THEN upper(json_extract_string(sex_ext, '$.valueCode'))
        END AS patient_gender
        , nullif(concat_ws(
            '  '
            , nullif(json_extract_string(bp_ext, '$.valueAddress.city'), '')
            , nullif(json_extract_string(bp_ext, '$.valueAddress.state'), '')
            , nullif(json_extract_string(bp_ext, '$.valueAddress.country'), '')
        ), '') AS birthplace
        , nullif(trim(json_extract_string(a1, '$.line[0]')), '') AS patient_address
        , nullif(trim(json_extract_string(a1, '$.city')), '') AS patient_city
        , nullif(trim(json_extract_string(a1, '$.state')), '') AS state_raw
        , nullif(trim(json_extract_string(a1, '$.postalCode')), '') AS patient_zip
        , CAST(json_extract_string(lat_obj, '$.valueDecimal') AS FLOAT) AS patient_latitude
        , CAST(json_extract_string(lon_obj, '$.valueDecimal') AS FLOAT) AS patient_longitude
    FROM parts3

)

        ) AS encounter_reason_description

        ORDER BY TRY_CAST(t.key AS INTEGER), TRY_CAST(c.key AS INTEGER)

        FROM json_each(e.resource, '$.reasonCode') AS r,

            AT TIME ZONE 'UTC'
        ) AS start_datetime,
        (
            TRY_CAST(json_extract_string(resource, '$.period.end') AS TIMESTAMPTZ)
            AT TIME ZONE 'UTC'
        ) AS stop_datetime,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.subject.reference') AS patient_reference,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.serviceProvider.reference') AS organization_reference,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.class.code') AS class_code,
        resource
    FROM {{ source('raw_fhir_r4', 'encounter') }}
),

selected AS (
    SELECT
        e.*,
        participant.reference AS provider_reference,
        participant.display AS provider_display,
        encounter_type.code AS encounter_code,
        encounter_type.description AS encounter_description,
        reason.code AS encounter_reason_code,
        reason.description AS encounter_reason_description
    FROM extracted AS e
    LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
        SELECT
            json_extract_string(p.value, '$.individual.reference') AS reference,
            json_extract_string(p.value, '$.individual.display') AS display
        FROM json_each(e.resource, '$.participant') AS p
        ORDER BY
            CASE WHEN EXISTS (
                SELECT 1
                FROM json_each(p.value, '$.type') AS t,
                     LATERAL json_each(t.value, '$.coding') AS c
                WHERE json_extract_string(c.value, '$.code') = 'PPRF'
            ) THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,
            TRY_CAST(p.key AS INTEGER)
        LIMIT 1
    ) AS participant ON TRUE
    LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
        SELECT
            json_extract_string(c.value, '$.code') AS code,
            COALESCE(
                json_extract_string(c.value, '$.display'),
                json_extract_string(t.value, '$.text')
            ) AS description
        FROM json_each(e.resource, '$.type') AS t,
             LATERAL json_each(t.value, '$.coding') AS c
        ORDER BY
            CASE
                WHEN json_extract_string(c.value, '$.system') = 'http://snomed.info/sct'
                THEN 0 ELSE 1
            END,
            TRY_CAST(t.key AS INTEGER),
            TRY_CAST(c.key AS INTEGER)
        LIMIT 1
    ) AS encounter_type ON TRUE
    LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
        SELECT
            json_extract_string(c.value, '$.code') AS code,
            COALESCE(
                json_extract_string(c.value, '$.display'),
                json_extract_string(r.value, '$.text')
            ) AS description
        FROM json_each(e.resource, '$.reasonCode') AS r,
             LATERAL json_each(r.value, '$.coding') AS c
        WHERE json_extract_string(c.value, '$.system') = 'http://snomed.info/sct'
        ORDER BY TRY_CAST(r.key AS INTEGER), TRY_CAST(c.key AS INTEGER)
        LIMIT 1
    ) AS reason ON TRUE
),

normalized AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        NULLIF(
            regexp_extract(

                THEN 'wellness'
            WHEN upper(n.class_code) = 'AMB' THEN 'ambulatory'
            WHEN upper(n.class_code) = 'EMER' THEN 'emergency'
            WHEN upper(n.class_code) = 'IMP' THEN 'inpatient'
            WHEN upper(n.class_code) = 'OBSENC' THEN 'observation'
            WHEN upper(n.class_code) = 'SS' THEN 'shortstay'
            WHEN upper(n.class_code) = 'HH' THEN 'home'
            WHEN upper(n.class_code) = 'VR' THEN 'virtual'
            ELSE lower(n.class_code)
        END
    )::VARCHAR AS encounter_class,
    n.encounter_code::VARCHAR AS encounter_code,
    n.encounter_description::VARCHAR AS encounter_description,
    CAST(NULL AS FLOAT) AS base_encounter_cost,
    CAST(NULL AS FLOAT) AS total_encounter_cost,

    n.encounter_reason_code::VARCHAR AS encounter_reason_code,
    n.encounter_reason_description::VARCHAR AS encounter_reason_description
FROM normalized AS n
LEFT JOIN provider_lookup AS p
    ON n.organization_id = p.organization_id
   AND n.provider_name = p.provider_name

WITH cte_src AS (

    SELECT
        id AS raw_id
        , CAST(resource AS JSON) AS r
    FROM {{ source('raw_fhir_r4', 'encounter') }}

)

, cte_fields AS (

    SELECT
        lower(COALESCE(json_extract_string(r, '$.id'), raw_id)) AS encounter_id
        , COALESCE(
            json_extract_string(r, '$.period.start'),
            json_extract_string(r, '$.participant[0].period.start')
        ) AS start_txt
        , COALESCE(
            json_extract_string(r, '$.period.end'),
            json_extract_string(r, '$.participant[0].period.end')
        ) AS stop_txt
        , lower(regexp_extract(json_extract_string(r, '$.subject.reference'), '([^:/|]+)$', 1)) AS patient_id
        , lower(regexp_extract(json_extract_string(r, '$.serviceProvider.reference'), '([^:/|]+)$', 1)) AS organization_id
        , lower(trim(regexp_replace(
            COALESCE(json_extract_string(r, '$.participant[0].individual.display'), ''),
            '^(Dr|Mr|Mrs|Ms|Miss)\.?\s+', ''))) AS practitioner_name
        , json_extract_string(r, '$.class.code') AS fhir_class
        , json_extract_string(r, '$.type[0].coding[0].code') AS encounter_code
        , COALESCE(
            json_extract_string(r, '$.type[0].coding[0].display'),
            json_extract_string(r, '$.type[0].text')
        ) AS encounter_description
        , json_extract_string(r, '$.reasonCode[0].coding[0].code') AS encounter_reason_code
        , json_extract_string(r, '$.reasonCode[0].coding[0].display') AS encounter_reason_description
    FROM cte_src

)

, cte_providers AS (

    SELECT
        lower(trim("NAME")) AS provider_name
        , lower("ORGANIZATION") AS organization_id
        , lower(min("Id")) AS provider_id
    FROM {{ source('raw_fhir_r4', 'providers') }}
    GROUP BY lower(trim("NAME")), lower("ORGANIZATION")
    HAVING count(*) = 1

)

, cte_times AS (

    SELECT
        f.*
        , CASE
            WHEN start_txt IS NULL THEN NULL
            WHEN regexp_matches(start_txt, '(Z|[+-][0-9]{2}:?[0-9]{2})$')
                THEN CAST(CAST(start_txt AS TIMESTAMPTZ) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AS TIMESTAMP)
            ELSE CAST(start_txt AS TIMESTAMP)
          END AS start_ts
        , CASE
            WHEN stop_txt IS NULL THEN NULL
            WHEN regexp_matches(stop_txt, '(Z|[+-][0-9]{2}:?[0-9]{2})$')
                THEN CAST(CAST(stop_txt AS TIMESTAMPTZ) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AS TIMESTAMP)
            ELSE CAST(stop_txt AS TIMESTAMP)
          END AS stop_ts
    FROM cte_fields AS f

)

SELECT
    CAST(t.encounter_id AS VARCHAR) AS encounter_id
    , CAST(t.start_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS encounter_start_datetime
    , CAST(t.start_ts AS DATE) AS encounter_start_date
    , CAST(COALESCE(t.stop_ts, t.start_ts) AS TIMESTAMP) AS encounter_stop_datetime
    , CAST(COALESCE(CAST(t.start_ts AS DATE), CAST(t.stop_ts AS DATE)) AS DATE) AS encounter_stop_date
    , CAST(t.patient_id AS VARCHAR) AS patient_id
    , CAST(t.organization_id AS VARCHAR) AS organization_id
    , CAST(p.provider_id AS VARCHAR) AS provider_id
    , CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS payer_id
    , CAST(

            WHEN t.fhir_class = 'AMB' AND t.encounter_code IN ('162673000', '410620009') THEN 'wellness'
            WHEN t.fhir_class = 'AMB' AND t.encounter_code = '702927004' THEN 'urgentcare'
            WHEN t.fhir_class = 'AMB' AND t.encounter_code = '308335008' THEN 'outpatient'
            WHEN t.fhir_class = 'AMB' THEN 'ambulatory'
            WHEN t.fhir_class = 'EMER' THEN 'emergency'
            WHEN t.fhir_class = 'IMP' THEN 'inpatient'

        ) AS ssn,
        json_extract_string(
            resource,
            '$.identifier[?(@.type.coding[0].code == "DL")].value'
        ) AS drivers_license_number,
        json_extract_string(
            resource,
            '$.identifier[?(@.type.coding[0].code == "PPN")].value'
        ) AS passport_number,

        -- name parts
        json_extract_string(
            resource,
            '$.name[?(@.use == "official")].prefix[0]'
        ) AS patient_prefix,
        json_extract_string(
            resource,
            '$.name[?(@.use == "official")].given[0]'
        ) AS patient_first_name,
        json_extract_string(
            resource,
            '$.name[?(@.use == "official")].family'
        ) AS patient_last_name,
        json_extract_string(
            resource,
            '$.name[?(@.use == "official")].suffix[0]'
        ) AS patient_suffix,
        json_extract_string(
            resource,
            '$.name[?(@.use == "maiden")].family'
        ) AS maiden_name,

        -- marital status
        json_extract_string(
            resource,
            '$.maritalStatus.coding[0].code'
        ) AS marital_status,

        -- race / ethnicity (use the human‑readable text if present)
        COALESCE(
            json_extract_string(
                resource,
                '$.extension[?(@.url == "http://hl7.org/fhir/us/core/StructureDefinition/us-core-race")].extension[?(@.url == "text")].valueString'
            ),
            json_extract_string(
                resource,
                '$.extension[?(@.url == "http://hl7.org/fhir/us/core/StructureDefinition/us-core-race")].extension[?(@.url == "ombCategory")].valueCoding.display'
            )
        ) AS race,
        COALESCE(
            json_extract_string(
                resource,
                '$.extension[?(@.url == "http://hl7.org/fhir/us/core/StructureDefinition/us-core-ethnicity")].extension[?(@.url == "text")].valueString'
            ),

        CASE LOWER(json_extract_string(resource, '$.gender'))

            ELSE UPPER(SUBSTR(json_extract_string(resource, '$.gender'), 1, 1))
        END AS patient_gender,

        -- birthplace (city state country concatenated)
        CONCAT_WS(
            ' ',
            json_extract_string(
                resource,
                '$.extension[?(@.url == "http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/birthPlace")].valueAddress.city'
            ),
            json_extract_string(
                resource,
                '$.extension[?(@.url == "http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/birthPlace")].valueAddress.state'
            ),
            json_extract_string(
                resource,
                '$.extension[?(@.url == "http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/birthPlace")].valueAddress.country'
            )

        json_extract_string(resource, '$.address[0].state') AS patient_state,

        CAST(
            json_extract_string(
                resource,
                '$.address[0].extension[?(@.url == "http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/geolocation")].extension[?(@.url == "latitude")].valueDecimal'

        ) AS patient_latitude,

                '$.address[0].extension[?(@.url == "http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/geolocation")].extension[?(@.url == "longitude")].valueDecimal'
            ) AS DOUBLE
        ) AS patient_longitude,

        -- financial columns – not present in the FHIR payload
        NULL::DOUBLE AS healthcare_expenses,
        NULL::DOUBLE AS healthcare_coverage
    FROM source
)

WITH extracted AS (
    SELECT
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.onsetDateTime') AS onset_datetime,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.abatementDateTime') AS abatement_datetime,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.subject.reference') AS patient_reference,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.encounter.reference') AS encounter_reference,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.code.text') AS condition_text,
        json_extract(resource, '$.code.coding') AS codings
    FROM {{ source('raw_fhir_r4', 'condition') }}
),

selected_coding AS (
    SELECT
        extracted.*,
        coding.condition_code,
        coding.condition_display
    FROM extracted
    LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
        SELECT
            json_extract_string(value, '$.code') AS condition_code,
            json_extract_string(value, '$.display') AS condition_display
        FROM json_each(extracted.codings)
        WHERE NULLIF(json_extract_string(value, '$.code'), '') IS NOT NULL
        ORDER BY
            CASE
                WHEN json_extract_string(value, '$.system') = 'http://snomed.info/sct'
                    THEN 0
                ELSE 1
            END,
            TRY_CAST(key AS BIGINT)
        LIMIT 1
    ) AS coding ON TRUE
)

SELECT
    CASE
        WHEN length(onset_datetime) = 10
            THEN TRY_CAST(onset_datetime AS DATE)
        ELSE CAST(
            TRY_CAST(onset_datetime AS TIMESTAMPTZ) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC'
            AS DATE
        )
    END AS condition_start_date,
    CASE
        WHEN length(abatement_datetime) = 10
            THEN TRY_CAST(abatement_datetime AS DATE)
        ELSE CAST(
            TRY_CAST(abatement_datetime AS TIMESTAMPTZ) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC'
            AS DATE
        )
    END AS condition_stop_date,
    CAST(
        NULLIF(
            split_part(
                regexp_replace(patient_reference, '^urn:uuid:|^(.*/)?Patient/', ''),
                '/',
                1
            ),
            ''
        ) AS VARCHAR
    ) AS patient_id,
    CAST(
        NULLIF(
            split_part(
                regexp_replace(encounter_reference, '^urn:uuid:|^(.*/)?Encounter/', ''),
                '/',
                1
            ),
            ''
        ) AS VARCHAR
    ) AS encounter_id,
    CAST(condition_code AS VARCHAR) AS condition_code,
    CAST(
        COALESCE(NULLIF(condition_display, ''), condition_text)
        AS VARCHAR
    ) AS condition_description
FROM selected_coding

    select
        id as patient_id,
        resource
    from {{ source('raw_fhir_stu3', 'patient') }}
),

-- ------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Extract identifiers (SSN, DL, PPN)
-- ------------------------------------------------------------------
identifiers as (
    select
        r.patient_id,
        json_extract_string(i.value, '$.value')                     as identifier_value,
        json_extract_string(i.value, '$.type.coding[0].code')       as identifier_code
    from raw r
    left join lateral json_each(json_extract(r.resource, '$.identifier')) i on true
),

ssn as (
    select
        patient_id,
        max(case when identifier_code = 'SB' then identifier_value end) as ssn
    from identifiers
    group by patient_id
),

drivers as (
    select
        patient_id,
        max(case when identifier_code = 'DL' then identifier_value end) as drivers_license_number
    from identifiers
    group by patient_id
),

passports as (
    select
        patient_id,
        max(case when identifier_code = 'PPN' then identifier_value end) as passport_number
    from identifiers
    group by patient_id
),

-- ------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Extract names (official & maiden)
-- ------------------------------------------------------------------
names as (
    select
        r.patient_id,
        json_extract_string(off.value, '$.prefix[0]')               as patient_prefix,
        json_extract_string(off.value, '$.given[0]')                as patient_first_name,
        json_extract_string(off.value, '$.family')                  as patient_last_name,
        json_extract_string(off.value, '$.suffix[0]')               as patient_suffix,
        json_extract_string(maiden.value, '$.family')               as maiden_name
    from raw r
    left join lateral (
        select value
        from json_each(json_extract(r.resource, '$.name')) n
        where json_extract_string(n.value, '$.use') = 'official'
        limit 1
    ) off on true
    left join lateral (
        select value
        from json_each(json_extract(r.resource, '$.name')) n
        where json_extract_string(n.value, '$.use') = 'maiden'
        limit 1
    ) maiden on true
),

-- ------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Core patient fields
-- ------------------------------------------------------------------
core as (
    select
        r.patient_id,
        cast(json_extract_string(r.resource, '$.birthDate') as date)                                   as birth_date,
        case
            when json_extract_string(r.resource, '$.deceasedDateTime') is not null
                then cast(substr(json_extract_string(r.resource, '$.deceasedDateTime'),1,10) as date)
        end                                                                                           as death_date,
        json_extract_string(r.resource, '$.maritalStatus.coding[0].code')                              as marital_status,
        case lower(json_extract_string(r.resource, '$.gender'))
            when 'male'   then 'M'
            when 'female' then 'F'
            else null
        end                                                                                           as patient_gender,
        -- race (raw display string)
        json_extract_string(
            r.resource,
            '$.extension[?(@.url == "http://hl7.org/fhir/us/core/StructureDefinition/us-core-race")]' ||
            '.extension[?(@.url == "ombCategory")].valueCoding.display'
        )                                                                                               as race_raw,
        -- ethnicity (raw display string)
        json_extract_string(
            r.resource,
            '$.extension[?(@.url == "http://hl7.org/fhir/us/core/StructureDefinition/us-core-ethnicity")]' ||
            '.extension[?(@.url == "ombCategory")].valueCoding.display'
        )                                                                                               as ethnicity_raw,
        -- birthplace: city  state  country
        concat_ws('  ',
            json_extract_string(r.resource,
                '$.extension[?(@.url == "http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/birthPlace")].valueAddress.city'),
            json_extract_string(r.resource,
                '$.extension[?(@.url == "http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/birthPlace")].valueAddress.state'),
            json_extract_string(r.resource,
                '$.extension[?(@.url == "http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/birthPlace")].valueAddress.country')
        )                                                                                               as birthplace,
        -- address fields
        json_extract_string(r.resource, '$.address[0].line[0]')                                         as patient_address,
        json_extract_string(r.resource, '$.address[0].city')                                            as patient_city,
        json_extract_string(r.resource, '$.address[0].state')                                           as address_state,
        json_extract_string(r.resource, '$.address[0].postalCode')                                      as patient_zip,
        -- latitude / longitude from geolocation extension
        json_extract_double(
            r.resource,
            '$.address[0].extension[?(@.url == "http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/geolocation")]' ||
            '.extension[?(@.url == "latitude")].valueDecimal'
        )                                                                                               as patient_latitude,
        json_extract_double(
            r.resource,
            '$.address[0].extension[?(@.url == "http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/geolocation")]' ||
            '.extension[?(@.url == "longitude")].valueDecimal'
        )                                                                                               as patient_longitude
    from raw r
),

-- ------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Map state abbreviation to full name
-- ------------------------------------------------------------------
states as (
    select *
    from {{ ref('stg_map__states') }}
),

-- ------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Final projection matching the staging contract
-- ------------------------------------------------------------------
final as (
    select
        c.patient_id,
        c.birth_date,
        c.death_date,
        s.ssn,
        d.drivers_license_number,
        p.passport_number,
        n.patient_prefix,
        n.patient_first_name,
        n.patient_last_name,
        n.patient_suffix,
        n.maiden_name,
        c.marital_status,
        case lower(c.race_raw)
            when 'white'                                 then 'white'
            when 'black or african american'            then 'black'
            when 'asian'                                 then 'asian'
            when 'american indian or alaska native'     then 'native'
            when 'native hawaiian or other pacific islander' then 'hawaiian'
            else 'other'
        end                                            as race,
        case
            when lower(c.ethnicity_raw) like '%hispanic%' then 'hispanic'
            else 'nonhispanic'
        end                                            as ethnicity,
        c.patient_gender,
        c.birthplace,
        c.patient_address,
        c.patient_city,
        coalesce(st.state_name, c.address_state)      as patient_state,
        cast(null as varchar)                         as patient_county,
        c.patient_zip,
        c.patient_latitude,
        c.patient_longitude,
        cast(null as double)                          as healthcare_expenses,
        cast(null as double)                          as healthcare_coverage
    from core c
    left join ssn s          on s.patient_id = c.patient_id
    left join drivers d      on d.patient_id = c.patient_id
    left join passports p    on p.patient_id = c.patient_id
    left join names n        on n.patient_id = c.patient_id
    left join states st      on st.state_abbreviation = c.address_state
)

from final

        json_extract_string(e.resource, '$.reason[0].coding[0].display') as reason_display,
        json_extract_string(e.resource, '$.participant[0].individual.display') as provider_display
    from {{ source('raw_fhir_stu3', 'encounter') }} as e

provider_map as (
    select
        p.id as provider_id,
        p.organization as org_id,
        lower(p.name) as name_lc
    from {{ source('raw_fhir_stu3', 'providers') }} as p
),

-- join encounters with providers and compute final columns
final as (
    select
        -- identifiers
        r.encounter_id,
        -- datetime columns (UTC, naive)
        cast(r.start_str as timestamp) as encounter_start_datetime,
        cast(
            coalesce(r.end_str, r.start_str) as timestamp
        ) as encounter_stop_datetime,
        -- patient and organization ids
        regexp_replace(r.patient_ref, '^urn:uuid:', '') as patient_id,
        regexp_extract(r.org_ref, '\\|(.*)$', 1) as organization_id,
        -- provider lookup
        pm.provider_id,
        -- payer not available
        cast(null as varchar) as payer_id,
        -- encounter class mapping
        case
            when r.class_code = 'EMER' then 'emergency'
            when r.class_code = 'IMP' then 'inpatient'
            when r.class_code = 'AMB' then
                case
                    when r.type_code = '702927004' then 'urgentcare'
                    when r.type_code in ('162673000','410620009','308646001') then 'wellness'
                    else 'ambulatory'
                end
            else null
        end as encounter_class,
        -- code and description (commas replaced by spaces)
        r.type_code as encounter_code,
        replace(coalesce(r.type_display, r.type_text), ',', ' ') as encounter_description,

        cast(null as double) as base_encounter_cost,
        cast(null as double) as total_encounter_cost,
        cast(null as double) as encounter_payer_coverage,
        -- reason
        r.reason_code as encounter_reason_code,
        replace(r.reason_display, ',', ' ') as encounter_reason_description

        -- organization identifier (extract after final '|')
        CASE
            WHEN json_extract_string(resource, '$.serviceProvider.reference') LIKE '%|%' THEN
                regexp_extract(
                    json_extract_string(resource, '$.serviceProvider.reference'),
                    '\\|([^|]+)$',
                    1
                )
            ELSE
                split_part(json_extract_string(resource, '$.serviceProvider.reference'), '/', -1)
        END AS organization_id,

        -- provider identifier (extract NPI after '|')
        regexp_extract(
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.participant[0].individual.reference'),
            '\\|([^|]+)$',
            1
        ) AS provider_id,

        -- payer not present in FHIR Encounter
        NULL::VARCHAR AS payer_id,

        -- encounter class code (e.g., "AMB")
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.class.code') AS encounter_class,

        -- encounter type code
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.type[0].coding[0].code') AS encounter_code,

        -- description: prefer text, else display
        COALESCE(
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.type[0].text'),
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.type[0].coding[0].display')
        ) AS encounter_description,

        -- cost fields not present
        NULL::DOUBLE AS base_encounter_cost,
        NULL::DOUBLE AS total_encounter_cost,
        NULL::DOUBLE AS encounter_payer_coverage,

        -- reason code / description (may be missing)
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.reason[0].coding[0].code') AS encounter_reason_code,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.reason[0].coding[0].display') AS encounter_reason_description

    FROM source_encounters
)

    encounter_start_date,

    encounter_stop_date,
    patient_id,
    organization_id,

    encounter_description,

    total_encounter_cost,
    encounter_payer_coverage,
    encounter_reason_code,
    encounter_reason_description
FROM extracted

WITH cte_proc AS (

    SELECT
        id AS proc_id
        , resource
    FROM {{ source('raw_fhir_r4', 'procedure') }}

)

, cte_cond AS (

    SELECT
        id AS cond_id
        , json_extract_string(resource, '$.code.coding[0].code') AS cond_code
        , json_extract_string(resource, '$.code.coding[0].display') AS cond_display
    FROM {{ source('raw_fhir_r4', 'condition') }}

)

, cte_reason_refs AS (

    SELECT
        p.proc_id
        , t.i AS idx
        , replace(
            json_extract_string(p.resource, '$.reasonReference[' || t.i::VARCHAR || '].reference')
            , 'urn:uuid:', ''
        ) AS ref_id
        , json_extract_string(p.resource, '$.reasonReference[' || t.i::VARCHAR || '].display') AS ref_display
    FROM cte_proc AS p
    CROSS JOIN range(0, coalesce(json_array_length(json_extract(p.resource, '$.reasonReference')), 0)) AS t(i)

)

, cte_reason_pick AS (

    SELECT
        r.proc_id
        , c.cond_code AS reason_code
        , coalesce(c.cond_display, r.ref_display) AS reason_description
        , row_number() OVER (
            PARTITION BY r.proc_id
            ORDER BY CASE WHEN c.cond_id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, r.idx
        ) AS rn
    FROM cte_reason_refs AS r
    LEFT JOIN cte_cond AS c
        ON r.ref_id = c.cond_id

)

, cte_base AS (

    SELECT
        p.proc_id
        , CAST(coalesce(
            json_extract_string(p.resource, '$.performedPeriod.start')
            , json_extract_string(p.resource, '$.performedDateTime')
        ) AS TIMESTAMPTZ) AS start_tz
        , CAST(json_extract_string(p.resource, '$.performedPeriod.end') AS TIMESTAMPTZ) AS stop_tz
        , replace(json_extract_string(p.resource, '$.subject.reference'), 'urn:uuid:', '') AS patient_id
        , replace(json_extract_string(p.resource, '$.encounter.reference'), 'urn:uuid:', '') AS encounter_id
        , json_extract_string(p.resource, '$.code.coding[0].code') AS procedure_code
        , coalesce(
            json_extract_string(p.resource, '$.code.coding[0].display')
            , json_extract_string(p.resource, '$.code.text')
        ) AS procedure_description
    FROM cte_proc AS p

)

    , CAST(CAST(b.start_tz AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS procedure_start_date
    , CAST(b.stop_tz AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AS TIMESTAMP) AS procedure_stop_datetime
    , CAST(CAST(b.stop_tz AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS procedure_stop_date
    , CAST(b.patient_id AS VARCHAR) AS patient_id
    , CAST(b.encounter_id AS VARCHAR) AS encounter_id
    , CAST(b.procedure_code AS VARCHAR) AS procedure_code
    , CAST(b.procedure_description AS VARCHAR) AS procedure_description
    , CAST(NULL AS FLOAT) AS procedure_base_cost

            LIMIT 1
        ) AS observation_coding,

            ELSE [o.resource]
        END

    SELECT
        o.resource AS parent_resource,
        v.value_resource
    FROM {{ source('raw_fhir_r4', 'observation') }} AS o
    CROSS JOIN UNNEST(

observation_values as (

        r.resource as parent_resource,
        c.value as value_resource
    from raw_observations as r
    cross join lateral json_each(r.resource, '$.component') as c
    where coalesce(json_array_length(r.resource, '$.component'), 0) > 0

        resource as value_resource
    from raw_observations
    where coalesce(json_array_length(resource, '$.component'), 0) = 0
),

mapped as (
    select
        try_cast(
            json_extract_string(parent_resource, '$.effectiveDateTime')
            as timestamptz
        ) at time zone 'UTC' as observation_datetime,

        regexp_replace(
            json_extract_string(parent_resource, '$.subject.reference'),
            '^(urn:uuid:|.*/)',
            ''
        ) as patient_id,

        regexp_replace(
            coalesce(
                json_extract_string(parent_resource, '$.encounter.reference'),
                json_extract_string(parent_resource, '$.context.reference')
            ),
            '^(urn:uuid:|.*/)',
            ''
        ) as encounter_id,

        json_extract_string(
            parent_resource, '$.category[0].coding[0].code'
        ) as observation_category,

        json_extract_string(
            value_resource, '$.code.coding[0].code'
        ) as observation_code,

        replace(
            coalesce(
                json_extract_string(value_resource, '$.code.coding[0].display'),
                json_extract_string(value_resource, '$.code.text')
            ),
            ',',
            ' '
        ) as observation_description,

        case
            when (value_resource -> '$.valueQuantity') is not null then
                printf(
                    '%.1f',
                    try_cast(
                        json_extract_string(

                coalesce(
                    json_extract_string(

                    json_extract_string(
                        value_resource, '$.valueCodeableConcept.text'
                    ),
                    json_extract_string(value_resource, '$.valueString')

                ',',
                ' '
            )
        end as observation_value,

        replace(
            json_extract_string(value_resource, '$.valueQuantity.unit'),
            ',',
            ' '
        ) as observation_units,

        case
            when (value_resource -> '$.valueQuantity') is not null
                then 'numeric'
            else 'text'
        end as observation_value_type
    from observation_values
)

WITH src AS (

    SELECT
        id
        , CAST(resource AS JSON) AS resource
    FROM {{ source('raw_fhir_r4', 'observation') }}
    WHERE json_extract_string(resource, '$.resourceType') = 'Observation'

)

, parent_rows AS (

    -- resources without components: the resource itself is the observation
    SELECT
        id
        , resource
        , resource AS node
    FROM src
    WHERE COALESCE(json_array_length(json_extract(resource, '$.component')), 0) = 0

)

, component_rows AS (

    -- resources with components: one observation per component (as in the acquirer's flat rows)
    SELECT
        id
        , resource
        , UNNEST(from_json(json_extract(resource, '$.component'), '["json"]')) AS node
    FROM src
    WHERE COALESCE(json_array_length(json_extract(resource, '$.component')), 0) > 0

)

, all_nodes AS (

    SELECT * FROM parent_rows
    UNION ALL
    SELECT * FROM component_rows

)

, extracted AS (

    SELECT
        CAST(json_extract_string(resource, '$.effectiveDateTime') AS TIMESTAMPTZ) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AS observation_datetime
        , regexp_replace(json_extract_string(resource, '$.subject.reference'), '^(urn:uuid:|Patient/)', '') AS patient_id
        , regexp_replace(json_extract_string(resource, '$.encounter.reference'), '^(urn:uuid:|Encounter/)', '') AS encounter_id
        , json_extract_string(resource, '$.category[0].coding[0].code') AS observation_category
        , json_extract_string(node, '$.code.coding[0].code') AS observation_code
        , COALESCE(
            json_extract_string(node, '$.code.coding[0].display')
            , json_extract_string(node, '$.code.text')
        ) AS observation_description
        , json_extract_string(node, '$.valueQuantity.value') AS quantity_value
        , json_extract_string(node, '$.valueQuantity.unit') AS quantity_unit
        , COALESCE(
            json_extract_string(node, '$.valueCodeableConcept.text')
            , json_extract_string(node, '$.valueCodeableConcept.coding[0].display')
            , json_extract_string(node, '$.valueString')
        ) AS text_value
    FROM all_nodes

)

SELECT
    CAST(observation_datetime AS TIMESTAMP) AS observation_datetime
    , CAST(observation_datetime AS DATE) AS observation_date
    , CAST(lower(patient_id) AS VARCHAR) AS patient_id
    , CAST(lower(encounter_id) AS VARCHAR) AS encounter_id
    , CAST(observation_category AS VARCHAR) AS observation_category
    , CAST(observation_code AS VARCHAR) AS observation_code
    , CAST(observation_description AS VARCHAR) AS observation_description
    , CAST(COALESCE(quantity_value, text_value) AS VARCHAR) AS observation_value
    , CAST(CASE WHEN quantity_value IS NOT NULL THEN quantity_unit END AS VARCHAR) AS observation_units
    , CAST(
        CASE
            WHEN quantity_value IS NOT NULL THEN 'numeric'
            WHEN text_value IS NOT NULL THEN 'text'
        END AS VARCHAR
    ) AS observation_value_type
FROM extracted

        id
        , resource
        , COALESCE(json_array_length(resource -> '$.component'), 0) AS n_components
    FROM {{ source('raw_fhir_r4', 'observation') }}
    WHERE resource ->> '$.resourceType' = 'Observation'

)

, nodes AS (

    -- observations without components: the resource itself is the record
    SELECT
        resource
        , resource AS node
    FROM obs
    WHERE n_components = 0

    UNION ALL

    -- observations with components (blood pressure, surveys): one record per component
    SELECT
        o.resource
        , t.comp AS node
    FROM obs AS o
    CROSS JOIN UNNEST(CAST(o.resource -> '$.component' AS JSON[])) AS t(comp)
    WHERE o.n_components > 0

)

        -- identifiers
        "Patient account number"            AS patient_id,

        TRY_CAST(NULLIF("Claim primary payer paid amount", '') AS DOUBLE) AS medication_payer_coverage,
        TRY_CAST(NULLIF("Quantity dispensed", '')            AS DOUBLE) AS dispenses,

                    THEN CAST(r->'$.component' AS JSON[])
                ELSE [CAST(NULL AS JSON)]
            END
        ) AS c
    FROM src

    FROM exploded

        ) AS encounter_ref

        , coalesce(
            json_extract_string(n, '$.code.coding[0].display')
            , json_extract_string(n, '$.code.text')
        ) AS code_display
        , (n->'$.valueQuantity') IS NOT NULL AS has_quantity
        , try_cast(json_extract_string(n, '$.valueQuantity.value') AS DOUBLE) AS qty_value
        , json_extract_string(n, '$.valueQuantity.unit') AS qty_unit
        , coalesce(
            json_extract_string(n, '$.valueCodeableConcept.coding[0].display')
            , json_extract_string(n, '$.valueString')
        ) AS text_value
    FROM nodes

)

SELECT
    CAST(
        CASE
            WHEN eff IS NULL THEN NULL
            WHEN length(eff) = 10 THEN CAST((eff || ' 00:00:00+00') AS TIMESTAMPTZ)
            WHEN regexp_matches(eff, '(Z|[+-][0-9][0-9](:?[0-9][0-9])?)$') THEN CAST(eff AS TIMESTAMPTZ)
            ELSE CAST((replace(eff, 'T', ' ') || '+00') AS TIMESTAMPTZ)
        END AT TIME ZONE 'UTC'
        AS TIMESTAMP
    ) AS observation_datetime
    , CAST(
        CAST(
            CASE
                WHEN eff IS NULL THEN NULL
                WHEN length(eff) = 10 THEN CAST((eff || ' 00:00:00+00') AS TIMESTAMPTZ)
                WHEN regexp_matches(eff, '(Z|[+-][0-9][0-9](:?[0-9][0-9])?)$') THEN CAST(eff AS TIMESTAMPTZ)

    , CAST(

        p.*,
        (
            SELECT n.value
            FROM json_each(p.resource, '$.name') AS n
            WHERE json_extract_string(n.value, '$.use') IS DISTINCT FROM 'maiden'
            ORDER BY
                CASE json_extract_string(n.value, '$.use')
                    WHEN 'official' THEN 0
                    WHEN 'usual' THEN 1
                    ELSE 2
                END,
                CAST(n.key AS INTEGER)
            LIMIT 1
        ) AS patient_name,
        (
            SELECT json_extract_string(n.value, '$.family')
            FROM json_each(p.resource, '$.name') AS n
            WHERE json_extract_string(n.value, '$.use') = 'maiden'
            ORDER BY CAST(n.key AS INTEGER)
            LIMIT 1
        ) AS maiden_family,
        (
            SELECT a.value
            FROM json_each(p.resource, '$.address') AS a
            ORDER BY
                CASE json_extract_string(a.value, '$.use')
                    WHEN 'home' THEN 0
                    ELSE 1
                END,
                CAST(a.key AS INTEGER)
            LIMIT 1
        ) AS patient_address_json,
        (
            SELECT e.value
            FROM json_each(p.resource, '$.extension') AS e
            WHERE json_extract_string(e.value, '$.url')
                = 'http://hl7.org/fhir/us/core/StructureDefinition/us-core-race'
            ORDER BY CAST(e.key AS INTEGER)
            LIMIT 1
        ) AS race_extension,
        (
            SELECT e.value
            FROM json_each(p.resource, '$.extension') AS e
            WHERE json_extract_string(e.value, '$.url')
                = 'http://hl7.org/fhir/us/core/StructureDefinition/us-core-ethnicity'
            ORDER BY CAST(e.key AS INTEGER)
            LIMIT 1
        ) AS ethnicity_extension,
        (
            SELECT json_extract(e.value, '$.valueAddress')
            FROM json_each(p.resource, '$.extension') AS e
            WHERE json_extract_string(e.value, '$.url')
                = 'http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/birthPlace'
            ORDER BY CAST(e.key AS INTEGER)
            LIMIT 1
        ) AS birthplace_address
    FROM resources AS p
),

extracted AS (
    SELECT
        p.*,
        (
            SELECT json_extract_string(i.value, '$.value')
            FROM json_each(p.resource, '$.identifier') AS i
            WHERE json_extract_string(i.value, '$.system')
                = 'https://github.com/synthetichealth/synthea'
            ORDER BY CAST(i.key AS INTEGER)
            LIMIT 1
        ) AS synthea_id,
        (
            SELECT json_extract_string(i.value, '$.value')
            FROM json_each(p.resource, '$.identifier') AS i
            WHERE json_extract_string(i.value, '$.system')
                    = 'http://hl7.org/fhir/sid/us-ssn'
                OR EXISTS (
                    SELECT 1
                    FROM json_each(i.value, '$.type.coding') AS c
                    WHERE json_extract_string(c.value, '$.code') IN ('SS', 'SB')
                )
            ORDER BY CAST(i.key AS INTEGER)
            LIMIT 1
        ) AS ssn_value,
        (
            SELECT json_extract_string(i.value, '$.value')
            FROM json_each(p.resource, '$.identifier') AS i
            WHERE EXISTS (
                SELECT 1
                FROM json_each(i.value, '$.type.coding') AS c
                WHERE json_extract_string(c.value, '$.code') = 'DL'
            )
            ORDER BY CAST(i.key AS INTEGER)
            LIMIT 1
        ) AS drivers_value,
        (
            SELECT json_extract_string(i.value, '$.value')
            FROM json_each(p.resource, '$.identifier') AS i
            WHERE json_extract_string(i.value, '$.system')
                    = 'http://standardhealthrecord.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/passportNumber'
                OR EXISTS (
                    SELECT 1
                    FROM json_each(i.value, '$.type.coding') AS c
                    WHERE json_extract_string(c.value, '$.code') = 'PPN'
                )
            ORDER BY CAST(i.key AS INTEGER)
            LIMIT 1
        ) AS passport_value,
        (
            SELECT json_extract_string(e.value, '$.valueCoding.code')
            FROM json_each(p.race_extension, '$.extension') AS e
            WHERE json_extract_string(e.value, '$.url') = 'ombCategory'
            ORDER BY CAST(e.key AS INTEGER)
            LIMIT 1
        ) AS race_code,
        (
            SELECT json_extract_string(e.value, '$.valueCoding.code')
            FROM json_each(p.ethnicity_extension, '$.extension') AS e
            WHERE json_extract_string(e.value, '$.url') = 'ombCategory'
            ORDER BY CAST(e.key AS INTEGER)
            LIMIT 1
        ) AS ethnicity_code,
        (
            SELECT json_extract_string(c.value, '$.code')
            FROM json_each(p.resource, '$.maritalStatus.coding') AS c
            ORDER BY
                CASE
                    WHEN json_extract_string(c.value, '$.system')
                        = 'http://hl7.org/fhir/v3/MaritalStatus' THEN 0
                    ELSE 1
                END,
                CAST(c.key AS INTEGER)
            LIMIT 1
        ) AS marital_code,
        (
            SELECT e.value
            FROM json_each(p.patient_address_json, '$.extension') AS e
            WHERE json_extract_string(e.value, '$.url')
                = 'http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/geolocation'
            ORDER BY CAST(e.key AS INTEGER)
            LIMIT 1
        ) AS geolocation
    FROM selected AS p
)

SELECT
    CAST(
        COALESCE(
            NULLIF(synthea_id, ''),
            NULLIF(json_extract_string(resource, '$.id'), ''),
            raw_id
        ) AS VARCHAR
    ) AS patient_id,
    TRY_CAST(json_extract_string(resource, '$.birthDate') AS DATE) AS birth_date,
    CAST(
        timezone(
            'UTC',
            TRY_CAST(
                json_extract_string(resource, '$.deceasedDateTime')
                AS TIMESTAMPTZ
            )
        ) AS DATE
    ) AS death_date,
    CAST(ssn_value AS VARCHAR) AS ssn,
    CAST(drivers_value AS VARCHAR) AS drivers_license_number,
    CAST(passport_value AS VARCHAR) AS passport_number,
    json_extract_string(patient_name, '$.prefix[0]') AS patient_prefix,
    json_extract_string(patient_name, '$.given[0]') AS patient_first_name,
    json_extract_string(patient_name, '$.family') AS patient_last_name,
    json_extract_string(patient_name, '$.suffix[0]') AS patient_suffix,
    -- A mother's maiden name is not the patient's own maiden surname.
    CAST(maiden_family AS VARCHAR) AS maiden_name,
    CAST(COALESCE(
        marital_code,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.maritalStatus.text')
    ) AS VARCHAR) AS marital_status,
    CAST(
        CASE race_code
            WHEN '1002-5' THEN 'native'
            WHEN '2028-9' THEN 'asian'
            WHEN '2054-5' THEN 'black'
            WHEN '2076-8' THEN 'hawaiian'
            WHEN '2106-3' THEN 'white'
            WHEN '2131-1' THEN 'other'
        END AS VARCHAR
    ) AS race,
    CAST(
        CASE ethnicity_code
            WHEN '2135-2' THEN 'hispanic'
            WHEN '2186-5' THEN 'nonhispanic'
        END AS VARCHAR
    ) AS ethnicity,
    CAST(
        CASE lower(json_extract_string(resource, '$.gender'))
            WHEN 'male' THEN 'M'
            WHEN 'female' THEN 'F'
        END AS VARCHAR
    ) AS patient_gender,
    NULLIF(
        concat_ws(
            '  ',
            NULLIF(json_extract_string(birthplace_address, '$.city'), ''),
            COALESCE(
                (
                    SELECT s.state_name
                    FROM {{ ref('stg_map__states') }} AS s
                    WHERE lower(s.state_abbreviation) = lower(
                        json_extract_string(birthplace_address, '$.state')
                    )
                    ORDER BY s.state_name
                    LIMIT 1
                ),
                NULLIF(json_extract_string(birthplace_address, '$.state'), '')
            ),
            NULLIF(json_extract_string(birthplace_address, '$.country'), '')
        ),
        ''
    ) AS birthplace,
    (
        SELECT string_agg(
            json_extract_string(l.value, '$'),
            ' ' ORDER BY CAST(l.key AS INTEGER)
        )
        FROM json_each(patient_address_json, '$.line') AS l
    ) AS patient_address,
    json_extract_string(patient_address_json, '$.city') AS patient_city,
    COALESCE(
        (
            SELECT s.state_name
            FROM {{ ref('stg_map__states') }} AS s
            WHERE lower(s.state_abbreviation) = lower(
                json_extract_string(patient_address_json, '$.state')
            )
            ORDER BY s.state_name
            LIMIT 1
        ),
        json_extract_string(patient_address_json, '$.state')
    ) AS patient_state,
    json_extract_string(patient_address_json, '$.district') AS patient_county,
    json_extract_string(patient_address_json, '$.postalCode') AS patient_zip,
    TRY_CAST(
        (
            SELECT json_extract_string(e.value, '$.valueDecimal')
            FROM json_each(geolocation, '$.extension') AS e
            WHERE json_extract_string(e.value, '$.url') = 'latitude'
            ORDER BY CAST(e.key AS INTEGER)
            LIMIT 1
        ) AS FLOAT
    ) AS patient_latitude,
    TRY_CAST(
        (
            SELECT json_extract_string(e.value, '$.valueDecimal')
            FROM json_each(geolocation, '$.extension') AS e
            WHERE json_extract_string(e.value, '$.url') = 'longitude'
            ORDER BY CAST(e.key AS INTEGER)
            LIMIT 1
        ) AS FLOAT
    ) AS patient_longitude,
    CAST(NULL AS FLOAT) AS healthcare_expenses,
    CAST(NULL AS FLOAT) AS healthcare_coverage
FROM extracted

            WHERE json_extract_string(n.value, '$.use') = 'official'
            ORDER BY try_cast(n.key AS INTEGER)
            LIMIT 1
        ) AS official_name,
        (
            SELECT json_extract_string(n.value, '$.family')
            FROM json_each(p.resource, '$.name') AS n
            WHERE json_extract_string(n.value, '$.use') = 'maiden'

            WHERE json_extract_string(i.value, '$.type.coding[0].code') IN ('SS', 'SB')
               OR json_extract_string(i.value, '$.system') = 'http://hl7.org/fhir/sid/us-ssn'
            ORDER BY try_cast(i.key AS INTEGER)
            LIMIT 1
        ) AS ssn,
        (
            SELECT json_extract_string(i.value, '$.value')
            FROM json_each(p.resource, '$.identifier') AS i
            WHERE json_extract_string(i.value, '$.type.coding[0].code') = 'DL'
            ORDER BY try_cast(i.key AS INTEGER)

            WHERE json_extract_string(i.value, '$.type.coding[0].code') = 'PPN'
            ORDER BY try_cast(i.key AS INTEGER)
            LIMIT 1
        ) AS passport_number,

            WHERE json_extract_string(e.value, '$.url')

            ORDER BY try_cast(e.key AS INTEGER)
            LIMIT 1
        ) AS race_extension,
        (
            SELECT e.value
            FROM json_each(p.resource, '$.extension') AS e
            WHERE json_extract_string(e.value, '$.url')

    CASE

    CASE json_extract_string(n.resource, '$.gender')
