    cast(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS patient_county,
    json_extract_string(n.patient_address_json, '$.postalCode') AS patient_zip,
    try_cast(
        (
            SELECT json_extract_string(c.value, '$.valueDecimal')
            FROM json_each(n.geolocation, '$.extension') AS c
            WHERE json_extract_string(c.value, '$.url') = 'latitude'
            ORDER BY try_cast(c.key AS INTEGER)
            LIMIT 1
        ) AS FLOAT
    ) AS patient_latitude,
    try_cast(
        (
            SELECT json_extract_string(c.value, '$.valueDecimal')
            FROM json_each(n.geolocation, '$.extension') AS c
            WHERE json_extract_string(c.value, '$.url') = 'longitude'
            ORDER BY try_cast(c.key AS INTEGER)
            LIMIT 1
        ) AS FLOAT
    ) AS patient_longitude,
    cast(NULL AS FLOAT) AS healthcare_expenses,
    cast(NULL AS FLOAT) AS healthcare_coverage
FROM normalized AS n

WITH extracted AS (
    SELECT
        COALESCE(json_extract_string(resource, '$.id'), id)::VARCHAR AS encounter_id,
        (
            TRY_CAST(json_extract_string(resource, '$.period.start') AS TIMESTAMPTZ)
            AT TIME ZONE 'UTC'
        ) AS encounter_start_datetime,
        (
            TRY_CAST(json_extract_string(resource, '$.period.end') AS TIMESTAMPTZ)
            AT TIME ZONE 'UTC'
        ) AS period_end_datetime,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.subject.reference') AS patient_reference,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.serviceProvider.reference') AS organization_reference,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.participant[0].individual.reference') AS provider_reference,
        TRIM(
            regexp_replace(
                json_extract_string(resource, '$.participant[0].individual.display'),
                '^Dr[.]?\s+',
                '',
                'i'
            )
        ) AS provider_name,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.class.code') AS class_code,
        encounter_type.code AS encounter_code,
        COALESCE(
            encounter_type.display,
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.type[0].text')
        ) AS encounter_description,
        reason.code AS encounter_reason_code,
        COALESCE(
            reason.display,
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.reason[0].text')
        ) AS encounter_reason_description
    FROM {{ source('raw_fhir_stu3', 'encounter') }} AS e
    LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
        SELECT
            json_extract_string(c.value, '$.code') AS code,
            json_extract_string(c.value, '$.display') AS display
        FROM json_each(e.resource, '$.type') AS t,
             json_each(t.value, '$.coding') AS c
        WHERE json_extract_string(c.value, '$.system') = 'http://snomed.info/sct'
        ORDER BY TRY_CAST(t.key AS INTEGER), TRY_CAST(c.key AS INTEGER)
        LIMIT 1
    ) AS encounter_type ON TRUE
    LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
        SELECT
            json_extract_string(c.value, '$.code') AS code,
            json_extract_string(c.value, '$.display') AS display
        FROM json_each(e.resource, '$.reason') AS r,
             json_each(r.value, '$.coding') AS c
        WHERE json_extract_string(c.value, '$.system') = 'http://snomed.info/sct'
        ORDER BY TRY_CAST(r.key AS INTEGER), TRY_CAST(c.key AS INTEGER)
        LIMIT 1
    ) AS reason ON TRUE
),
normalized AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        CASE
            WHEN patient_reference LIKE 'urn:uuid:%'
                THEN SUBSTR(patient_reference, 10)
            WHEN patient_reference NOT LIKE '%?%'
                THEN NULLIF(
                    regexp_extract(patient_reference, '(?:^|/)Patient/([^/]+)', 1),
                    ''
                )
        END AS patient_id,
        CASE
            WHEN organization_reference LIKE 'urn:uuid:%'
                THEN SUBSTR(organization_reference, 10)
            WHEN organization_reference LIKE '%?identifier=https://github.com/synthetichealth/synthea|%'
                THEN SPLIT_PART(organization_reference, '|', 2)
            WHEN organization_reference NOT LIKE '%?%'
                THEN NULLIF(
                    regexp_extract(organization_reference, '(?:^|/)Organization/([^/]+)', 1),
                    ''
                )
        END AS organization_id,
        CASE
            WHEN provider_reference LIKE 'urn:uuid:%'

WITH src AS (

    SELECT
        lower(coalesce(json_extract_string(resource, '$.id'), id)) AS patient_id
        , resource
        , from_json(json_extract(resource, '$.extension'), '["JSON"]') AS ext
        , from_json(json_extract(resource, '$.identifier'), '["JSON"]') AS ids
        , from_json(json_extract(resource, '$.name'), '["JSON"]') AS names
    FROM {{ source('raw_fhir_stu3', 'patient') }}
    WHERE coalesce(json_extract_string(resource, '$.resourceType'), 'Patient') = 'Patient'

)

, parts AS (

    SELECT
        patient_id
        , resource
        , list_filter(ext, x -> json_extract_string(x, '$.url') LIKE '%us-core-race')[1] AS race_ext
        , list_filter(ext, x -> json_extract_string(x, '$.url') LIKE '%us-core-ethnicity')[1] AS eth_ext
        , list_filter(ext, x -> json_extract_string(x, '$.url') LIKE '%birthPlace')[1] AS bp_ext
        , list_filter(ids, i -> json_extract_string(i, '$.type.coding[0].code') = 'SB')[1] AS ssn_id
        , list_filter(ids, i -> json_extract_string(i, '$.type.coding[0].code') = 'DL')[1] AS dl_id
        , list_filter(ids, i -> json_extract_string(i, '$.type.coding[0].code') = 'PPN')[1] AS ppn_id
        , coalesce(
            list_filter(names, n -> json_extract_string(n, '$.use') = 'official')[1]
            , names[1]
        ) AS official_name
        , list_filter(names, n -> json_extract_string(n, '$.use') = 'maiden')[1] AS maiden_nm
        , json_extract(resource, '$.address[0]') AS addr
    FROM src

)

, parts2 AS (

    SELECT
        p.*
        , list_filter(
            from_json(json_extract(race_ext, '$.extension'), '["JSON"]')
            , x -> json_extract_string(x, '$.url') = 'ombCategory'
        )[1] AS race_cat
        , list_filter(
            from_json(json_extract(eth_ext, '$.extension'), '["JSON"]')
            , x -> json_extract_string(x, '$.url') = 'ombCategory'
        )[1] AS eth_cat
        , list_filter(
            from_json(json_extract(addr, '$.extension'), '["JSON"]')
            , x -> json_extract_string(x, '$.url') LIKE '%geolocation'
        )[1] AS geo_ext
    FROM parts AS p

)

, parts3 AS (

    SELECT
        p.*
        , list_filter(
            from_json(json_extract(geo_ext, '$.extension'), '["JSON"]')
            , x -> json_extract_string(x, '$.url') = 'latitude'
        )[1] AS lat_ext
        , list_filter(
            from_json(json_extract(geo_ext, '$.extension'), '["JSON"]')
            , x -> json_extract_string(x, '$.url') = 'longitude'
        )[1] AS lon_ext
    FROM parts2 AS p

)

, flat AS (

    SELECT
        patient_id
        , try_cast(json_extract_string(resource, '$.birthDate') AS DATE) AS birth_date
        , CASE
            WHEN json_extract_string(resource, '$.deceasedDateTime') IS NULL THEN NULL
            ELSE CAST(
                timezone('UTC', try_cast(json_extract_string(resource, '$.deceasedDateTime') AS TIMESTAMPTZ))
                AS DATE)
          END AS death_date
        , json_extract_string(ssn_id, '$.value') AS ssn
        , json_extract_string(dl_id, '$.value') AS drivers_license_number
        , json_extract_string(ppn_id, '$.value') AS passport_number
        , json_extract_string(official_name, '$.prefix[0]') AS patient_prefix
        , json_extract_string(official_name, '$.given[0]') AS patient_first_name
        , json_extract_string(official_name, '$.family') AS patient_last_name
        , json_extract_string(official_name, '$.suffix[0]') AS patient_suffix
        , json_extract_string(maiden_nm, '$.family') AS maiden_name
        , coalesce(
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.maritalStatus.coding[0].code')
            , json_extract_string(resource, '$.maritalStatus.text')
          ) AS marital_status
        , CASE json_extract_string(race_cat, '$.valueCoding.code')
            WHEN '2106-3' THEN 'white'
            WHEN '2054-5' THEN 'black'
            WHEN '2028-9' THEN 'asian'
            WHEN '1002-5' THEN 'native'
            WHEN '2076-8' THEN 'hawaiian'
            WHEN '2131-1' THEN 'other'
            ELSE lower(json_extract_string(race_cat, '$.valueCoding.display'))
          END AS race
        , CASE json_extract_string(eth_cat, '$.valueCoding.code')
            WHEN '2186-5' THEN 'nonhispanic'
            WHEN '2135-2' THEN 'hispanic'
            ELSE NULL
          END AS ethnicity
        , CASE lower(json_extract_string(resource, '$.gender'))
            WHEN 'male' THEN 'M'
            WHEN 'female' THEN 'F'
            ELSE NULL
          END AS patient_gender
        , concat_ws(
            '  '
            , json_extract_string(bp_ext, '$.valueAddress.city')
            , json_extract_string(bp_ext, '$.valueAddress.state')
            , json_extract_string(bp_ext, '$.valueAddress.country')
          ) AS birthplace
        , json_extract_string(addr, '$.line[0]') AS patient_address
        , json_extract_string(addr, '$.city') AS patient_city
        , json_extract_string(addr, '$.state') AS raw_state
        , json_extract_string(addr, '$.postalCode') AS patient_zip
        , try_cast(json_extract_string(lat_ext, '$.valueDecimal') AS FLOAT) AS patient_latitude
        , try_cast(json_extract_string(lon_ext, '$.valueDecimal') AS FLOAT) AS patient_longitude
    FROM parts3

)

        , list_filter(ids, i -> json_extract_string(i, '$.type.coding[0].code') = 'DL')[1] AS dl_id
        , list_filter(ids, i -> json_extract_string(i, '$.type.coding[0].code') = 'PPN')[1] AS ppn_id
        , coalesce(
            list_filter(names, n -> json_extract_string(n, '$.use') = 'official')[1]
            , names[1]
        ) AS official_name
        , list_filter(names, n -> json_extract_string(n, '$.use') = 'maiden')[1] AS maiden_nm
        , json_extract(resource, '$.address[0]') AS addr

, parts2 AS (

        )[1] AS race_cat
        , list_filter(

        )[1] AS eth_cat
        , list_filter(

            , x -> json_extract_string(x, '$.url') = 'latitude'
        )[1] AS lat_ext
        , list_filter(

            AT TIME ZONE 'UTC'

            AT TIME ZONE 'UTC'
        )::TIMESTAMP AS end_datetime,

        json_extract_string(resource, '$.participant[0].individual.reference') AS provider_reference,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.participant[0].individual.display') AS provider_display,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.class.code') AS class_code,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.type[0].coding[0].code') AS encounter_code,
        COALESCE(
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.type[0].coding[0].display'),
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.type[0].text')
        ) AS encounter_description,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.reason[0].coding[0].code') AS encounter_reason_code,
        COALESCE(
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.reason[0].coding[0].display'),
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.reason[0].text')
        ) AS encounter_reason_description
    FROM {{ source('raw_fhir_stu3', 'encounter') }}
),
normalized AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        CASE
            WHEN patient_reference LIKE '%?identifier=%'
                THEN NULLIF(regexp_extract(patient_reference, '\|([^|]+)$', 1), '')
            WHEN starts_with(patient_reference, 'urn:uuid:')
                THEN substr(patient_reference, 10)
            ELSE NULLIF(
                regexp_extract(patient_reference, '([^/]+)(/_history/[^/]+)?$', 1),
                ''
            )
        END::VARCHAR AS patient_id,
        CASE
            WHEN organization_reference LIKE '%?identifier=%'
                THEN NULLIF(regexp_extract(organization_reference, '\|([^|]+)$', 1), '')
            WHEN starts_with(organization_reference, 'urn:uuid:')
                THEN substr(organization_reference, 10)
            ELSE NULLIF(
                regexp_extract(organization_reference, '([^/]+)(/_history/[^/]+)?$', 1),
                ''
            )
        END::VARCHAR AS organization_id,
        lower(trim(regexp_replace(
            provider_display,
            '^(Dr[.]?|Doctor)[[:space:]]+',
            '',

    GROUP BY "ORGANIZATION", lower(trim("NAME"))

            WHEN starts_with(e.provider_reference, 'urn:uuid:')
                THEN substr(e.provider_reference, 10)
            ELSE NULLIF(
                regexp_extract(

                    '([^/]+)(/_history/[^/]+)?$',
                    1
                ),
                ''
            )

            THEN 'wellness'
        WHEN upper(class_code) = 'AMB' AND encounter_code = '308335008'

        WHEN upper(class_code) = 'AMB' THEN 'ambulatory'
        WHEN upper(class_code) = 'EMER' THEN 'emergency'
        WHEN upper(class_code) IN ('IMP', 'ACUTE', 'NONAC') THEN 'inpatient'
        WHEN upper(class_code) = 'OBSENC' THEN 'observation'

    END::VARCHAR AS encounter_class,

    encounter_description::VARCHAR AS encounter_description,
    NULL::FLOAT AS base_encounter_cost,
    NULL::FLOAT AS total_encounter_cost,
    NULL::FLOAT AS encounter_payer_coverage,
    encounter_reason_code::VARCHAR AS encounter_reason_code,
    encounter_reason_description::VARCHAR AS encounter_reason_description
FROM resolved

raw_chg as (

),

joined as (
    select
        e.id as encounter_id,
        e.start_date,
        e.start_time,
        e.stop_date,
        e.stop_time,
        e.patient as patient_id,
        e.organization as organization_id,
        e.provider as provider_id,
        e.payer as payer_id,
        e.encounterclass as encounter_class,
        e.code_display,
        e.reason,
        c.base_encounter_cost,
        c.total_claim_cost,
        c.payer_coverage
    from raw_enc e
    left join raw_chg c
        on e.id = c.encounter_id
),

parsed as (
    select
        encounter_id,
        -- combine date and time strings into timestamps (assumed UTC)
        strptime(start_date || ' ' || start_time, '%m/%d/%Y %H:%M:%S') as encounter_start_datetime,

final as (

        encounter_reason_code,
        encounter_reason_description
    from parsed
)

from final

        , json_extract_string(resource, '$.subject.reference') AS subject_ref
        , json_extract_string(resource, '$.serviceProvider.reference') AS org_ref
        , json_extract_string(resource, '$.participant[0].individual.display') AS practitioner_display
        , json_extract_string(resource, '$.class.code') AS class_code
        , json_extract_string(resource, '$.type[0].coding[0].code') AS type_code
        , COALESCE(
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.type[0].coding[0].display'),
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.type[0].text')
        ) AS type_display
        , json_extract_string(resource, '$.reason[0].coding[0].code') AS reason_code
        , json_extract_string(resource, '$.reason[0].coding[0].display') AS reason_display
    FROM {{ source('raw_fhir_stu3', 'encounter') }}
    WHERE json_extract_string(resource, '$.resourceType') = 'Encounter'
       OR json_extract_string(resource, '$.resourceType') IS NULL

)

        , (start_tz AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS start_dt

            ELSE regexp_replace(org_ref, '^(urn:uuid:|Organization/)', '')

        , class_code
        , type_code

        , reason_code
        , reason_display
    FROM src

)

WITH conditions AS (
    SELECT
        coalesce(json_extract_string(resource, '$.id'), id) AS condition_id,
        (
            SELECT coding.value
            FROM json_each(resource, '$.code.coding') AS coding
            WHERE json_extract_string(coding.value, '$.system') = 'http://snomed.info/sct'
            ORDER BY cast(coding.key AS INTEGER)
            LIMIT 1
        ) AS snomed_coding,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.code.text') AS description
    FROM {{ source('raw_fhir_stu3', 'condition') }}
    QUALIFY row_number() OVER (
        PARTITION BY coalesce(json_extract_string(resource, '$.id'), id)
        ORDER BY cast(resource AS VARCHAR)
    ) = 1
),

procedures AS (
    SELECT
        timezone(
            'UTC',
            try_cast(
                coalesce(
                    json_extract_string(resource, '$.performedPeriod.start'),
                    json_extract_string(resource, '$.performedDateTime')
                ) AS TIMESTAMPTZ
            )
        ) AS start_datetime,
        timezone(
            'UTC',
            try_cast(
                json_extract_string(resource, '$.performedPeriod.end')
                AS TIMESTAMPTZ
            )
        ) AS stop_datetime,
        regexp_replace(
            regexp_replace(
                json_extract_string(resource, '$.subject.reference'),
                '^urn:uuid:', ''
            ),
            '^.*/Patient/|^Patient/|/_history/.*$', '', 'g'
        ) AS patient_id,
        regexp_replace(
            regexp_replace(
                json_extract_string(resource, '$.context.reference'),
                '^urn:uuid:', ''
            ),
            '^.*/Encounter/|^Encounter/|/_history/.*$', '', 'g'
        ) AS encounter_id,
        (
            SELECT coding.value
            FROM json_each(resource, '$.code.coding') AS coding
            WHERE json_extract_string(coding.value, '$.system') = 'http://snomed.info/sct'
            ORDER BY cast(coding.key AS INTEGER)
            LIMIT 1
        ) AS snomed_coding,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.code.text') AS description,
        regexp_replace(
            regexp_replace(
                json_extract_string(resource, '$.reasonReference[0].reference'),
                '^urn:uuid:', ''
            ),
            '^.*/Condition/|^Condition/|/_history/.*$', '', 'g'
        ) AS reason_condition_id,
        json_extract_string(
            resource, '$.reasonReference[0].display'
        ) AS reason_reference_description,
        (
            SELECT coding.value
            FROM json_each(resource, '$.reasonCode[0].coding') AS coding
            WHERE json_extract_string(coding.value, '$.system') = 'http://snomed.info/sct'
            ORDER BY cast(coding.key AS INTEGER)
            LIMIT 1
        ) AS reason_snomed_coding,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.reasonCode[0].text') AS reason_text
    FROM {{ source('raw_fhir_stu3', 'procedure') }}
)

        , json_extract_string(resource, '$.period.end') AS period_end
        , json_extract_string(resource, '$.subject.reference') AS subject_ref
        , json_extract_string(resource, '$.serviceProvider.reference') AS org_ref
        , json_extract_string(resource, '$.participant[0].individual.display') AS practitioner_display
        , json_extract_string(resource, '$.class.code') AS class_code
        , json_extract_string(resource, '$.type[0].coding[0].code') AS type_code
        , json_extract_string(resource, '$.type[0].coding[0].display') AS type_display
        , json_extract_string(resource, '$.type[0].text') AS type_text
        , json_extract_string(resource, '$.reason[0].coding[0].code') AS reason_code
        , json_extract_string(resource, '$.reason[0].coding[0].display') AS reason_display
    FROM {{ source('raw_fhir_stu3', 'encounter') }}
    WHERE json_extract_string(resource, '$.resourceType') = 'Encounter'

)

, provider_lookup AS (

    SELECT
        lower(trim("NAME")) AS provider_name_key
        , "ORGANIZATION" AS organization_id
        , min("Id") AS provider_id
    FROM {{ source('raw_fhir_stu3', 'providers') }}
    GROUP BY lower(trim("NAME")), "ORGANIZATION"

)

, cte_parsed AS (

    SELECT
        s.encounter_id
        , CAST(CAST(s.period_start AS TIMESTAMPTZ) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AS TIMESTAMP) AS encounter_start_datetime
        , CAST(CAST(s.period_end AS TIMESTAMPTZ) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AS TIMESTAMP) AS period_end_datetime
        , replace(s.subject_ref, 'urn:uuid:', '') AS patient_id
        , NULLIF(trim(split_part(s.org_ref, '|', 2)), '') AS organization_id
        , s.practitioner_display
        , s.class_code
        , s.type_code AS encounter_code
        , COALESCE(s.type_display, s.type_text) AS encounter_description
        , s.reason_code AS encounter_reason_code
        , s.reason_display AS encounter_reason_description
    FROM src AS s

)

, cte_joined AS (

    SELECT
        p.*
        , pl.provider_id
    FROM cte_parsed AS p
    LEFT JOIN provider_lookup AS pl
        ON pl.provider_name_key = lower(trim(regexp_replace(COALESCE(p.practitioner_display, ''), '^Dr\.\s+', '')))
        AND pl.organization_id = p.organization_id

)

SELECT
    CAST(encounter_id AS VARCHAR) AS encounter_id
    , CAST(encounter_start_datetime AS TIMESTAMP) AS encounter_start_datetime
    , CAST(encounter_start_datetime AS DATE) AS encounter_start_date
    , CAST(COALESCE(period_end_datetime, encounter_start_datetime) AS TIMESTAMP) AS encounter_stop_datetime
    , CAST(COALESCE(CAST(encounter_start_datetime AS DATE), CAST(period_end_datetime AS DATE)) AS DATE) AS encounter_stop_date
    , CAST(patient_id AS VARCHAR) AS patient_id
    , CAST(organization_id AS VARCHAR) AS organization_id
    , CAST(provider_id AS VARCHAR) AS provider_id
    , CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS payer_id
    , CAST(
        CASE
            WHEN upper(class_code) = 'AMB' THEN
                CASE
                    WHEN encounter_code IN ('162673000', '410620009', '170258001', '169230002') THEN 'wellness'
                    WHEN encounter_code = '308335008' THEN 'outpatient'
                    WHEN encounter_code = '702927004' THEN 'urgentcare'
                    ELSE 'ambulatory'
                END
            WHEN upper(class_code) = 'EMER' THEN 'emergency'
            WHEN upper(class_code) = 'IMP' THEN 'inpatient'

    select *
    from {{ source('raw_d2', 'allergies') }}

),

stg as (

    select
        -- dates (convert from "dd-MMM-yyyy" strings)
        to_date(raw_allergies.start, '%d-%b-%Y') as allergy_start_date,
        case
            when raw_allergies.stop is null or raw_allergies.stop = '' then null
            else to_date(raw_allergies.stop, '%d-%b-%Y')
        end as allergy_stop_date,

        -- identifiers
        raw_allergies.patient as patient_id,
        raw_allergies.encounter as encounter_id,

        nullif(split_part(raw_allergies.code_display, ' | ', 1), '') as allergy_code,
        raw_allergies.system as allergy_code_system,
        nullif(split_part(raw_allergies.code_display, ' | ', 2), '') as allergy_description,

        -- other attributes
        raw_allergies.type as allergy_type,
        raw_allergies.category as allergy_category,

        -- reactions (nullify empty strings)

WITH expanded AS (
    SELECT
        o.resource AS parent_resource,
        COALESCE(c.value, o.resource) AS value_resource
    FROM {{ source('raw_fhir_stu3', 'observation') }} AS o
    LEFT JOIN LATERAL json_each(o.resource, '$.component') AS c
        ON TRUE
),
mapped AS (
    SELECT
        timezone(
            'UTC',
            TRY_CAST(
                json_extract_string(parent_resource, '$.effectiveDateTime')
                AS TIMESTAMPTZ
            )
        ) AS observation_datetime,
        regexp_replace(
            json_extract_string(parent_resource, '$.subject.reference'),
            '^urn:uuid:|^(.*/)?Patient/',
            ''
        ) AS patient_id,
        regexp_replace(
            COALESCE(
                json_extract_string(parent_resource, '$.context.reference'),
                json_extract_string(parent_resource, '$.encounter.reference')
            ),
            '^urn:uuid:|^(.*/)?Encounter/',
            ''
        ) AS encounter_id,
        json_extract_string(
            parent_resource,
            '$.category[0].coding[0].code'
        ) AS observation_category,
        json_extract_string(
            value_resource,
            '$.code.coding[0].code'
        ) AS observation_code,
        replace(
            COALESCE(
                json_extract_string(value_resource, '$.code.text'),
                json_extract_string(value_resource, '$.code.coding[0].display')
            ),
            ',',
            ' '
        ) AS observation_description,
        CASE
            WHEN (value_resource->'$.valueQuantity') IS NOT NULL
                THEN printf(
                    '%.1f',
                    TRY_CAST(
                        json_extract_string(value_resource, '$.valueQuantity.value')
                        AS DOUBLE
                    )
                )
            ELSE replace(
                COALESCE(
                    json_extract_string(

                        '$.valueCodeableConcept.coding[0].display'

                    json_extract_string(value_resource, '$.valueString')

            ' '

        END AS observation_value_type
    FROM expanded

WITH allergy_values AS (
    SELECT
        resource,
        regexp_replace(
            regexp_replace(
                json_extract_string(resource, '$.patient.reference'),
                '^(urn:uuid:|.*/Patient/|Patient/)',
                ''
            ),
            '/_history/.*$',
            ''
        )::VARCHAR AS patient_id,
        coalesce(
            try_cast(json_extract_string(resource, '$.onsetDateTime') AS TIMESTAMPTZ),
            try_cast(json_extract_string(resource, '$.onsetPeriod.start') AS TIMESTAMPTZ),
            try_cast(json_extract_string(resource, '$.assertedDate') AS TIMESTAMPTZ)
        ) AS allergy_start_at,
        try_cast(
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.assertedDate') AS TIMESTAMPTZ
        ) AS asserted_at,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.code.coding[0].code') AS allergy_code,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.code.coding[0].system') AS code_system,
        coalesce(
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.code.coding[0].display'),
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.code.text')
        ) AS allergy_description
    FROM {{ source('raw_fhir_stu3', 'allergyintolerance') }}
),
encounters AS (
    SELECT
        coalesce(
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.id'),
            id
        )::VARCHAR AS encounter_id,
        regexp_replace(
            regexp_replace(
                json_extract_string(resource, '$.subject.reference'),
                '^(urn:uuid:|.*/Patient/|Patient/)',
                ''
            ),
            '/_history/.*$',
            ''
        )::VARCHAR AS patient_id,
        try_cast(
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.period.start') AS TIMESTAMPTZ
        ) AS encounter_start_at,
        try_cast(
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.period.end') AS TIMESTAMPTZ
        ) AS encounter_end_at
    FROM {{ source('raw_fhir_stu3', 'encounter') }}
)
SELECT
    cast(a.allergy_start_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AS DATE) AS allergy_start_date,
    cast(NULL AS DATE) AS allergy_stop_date,
    a.patient_id::VARCHAR AS patient_id,
    matched.encounter_id::VARCHAR AS encounter_id,
    a.allergy_code::VARCHAR AS allergy_code,
    cast(
        CASE a.code_system
            WHEN 'http://snomed.info/sct' THEN 'SNOMED-CT'
            WHEN 'https://snomed.info/sct' THEN 'SNOMED-CT'
            WHEN 'http://www.nlm.nih.gov/research/umls/rxnorm' THEN 'RxNorm'
            WHEN 'http://loinc.org' THEN 'LOINC'
            ELSE a.code_system
        END AS VARCHAR
    ) AS allergy_code_system,
    a.allergy_description::VARCHAR AS allergy_description,
    lower(json_extract_string(a.resource, '$.type'))::VARCHAR AS allergy_type,

        CASE lower(json_extract_string(a.resource, '$.category[0]'))
            WHEN 'environmental' THEN 'environment'
            ELSE lower(json_extract_string(a.resource, '$.category[0]'))
        END AS VARCHAR
    ) AS allergy_category,

            json_extract_string(resource, '$.onsetDateTime'),
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.onsetPeriod.start'),
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.assertedDate')
        ) AS start_value,
        try_cast(
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.assertedDate') AS TIMESTAMPTZ
        ) AS asserted_at,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.code.coding[0].system') AS code_system
    FROM {{ source('raw_fhir_stu3', 'allergyintolerance') }}

allergies AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        cast(
            regexp_replace(
                regexp_replace(
                    regexp_replace(patient_reference, '/_history/[^/]+$', ''),
                    '^urn:uuid:',
                    ''
                ),
                '^.*/',
                ''
            ) AS VARCHAR
        ) AS patient_id,
        cast(
            regexp_replace(
                regexp_replace(
                    regexp_replace(encounter_reference, '/_history/[^/]+$', ''),
                    '^urn:uuid:',
                    ''
                ),
                '^.*/',
                ''
            ) AS VARCHAR
        ) AS explicit_encounter_id
    FROM allergy_values
),

encounters AS (
    SELECT
        coalesce(
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.id'),
            id
        )::VARCHAR AS encounter_id,
        regexp_replace(
            regexp_replace(
                regexp_replace(
                    json_extract_string(resource, '$.subject.reference'),
                    '/_history/[^/]+$',
                    ''
                ),
                '^urn:uuid:',
                ''
            ),
            '^.*/',
            ''
        ) AS patient_id,
        try_cast(
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.period.start') AS TIMESTAMPTZ
        ) AS start_at,
        try_cast(
            json_extract_string(resource, '$.period.end') AS TIMESTAMPTZ
        ) AS end_at
    FROM {{ source('raw_fhir_stu3', 'encounter') }}
)

SELECT
    cast(
        timezone('UTC', try_cast(a.start_value AS TIMESTAMPTZ))
        AS DATE
    ) AS allergy_start_date,

    -- STU3 clinicalStatus does not supply an allergy resolution date.
    cast(NULL AS DATE) AS allergy_stop_date,

    a.patient_id::VARCHAR AS patient_id,
    coalesce(a.explicit_encounter_id, matched.encounter_id)::VARCHAR AS encounter_id,
    json_extract_string(a.resource, '$.code.coding[0].code')::VARCHAR AS allergy_code,

    cast(
        CASE a.code_system
            WHEN 'http://snomed.info/sct' THEN 'SNOMED-CT'
            WHEN 'https://snomed.info/sct' THEN 'SNOMED-CT'
            WHEN 'http://www.nlm.nih.gov/research/umls/rxnorm' THEN 'RxNorm'
            ELSE a.code_system
        END AS VARCHAR
    ) AS allergy_code_system,

    coalesce(
        json_extract_string(a.resource, '$.code.coding[0].display'),
        json_extract_string(a.resource, '$.code.text')
    )::VARCHAR AS allergy_description,

    lower(json_extract_string(a.resource, '$.type'))::VARCHAR AS allergy_type,
    lower(json_extract_string(a.resource, '$.category[0]'))::VARCHAR AS allergy_category,

    json_extract_string(
        a.resource, '$.reaction[0].manifestation[0].coding[0].code'
    )::VARCHAR AS reaction_1_code,

    coalesce(
        json_extract_string(
            a.resource, '$.reaction[0].manifestation[0].coding[0].display'
        ),
        json_extract_string(
            a.resource, '$.reaction[0].manifestation[0].text'
        )
    )::VARCHAR AS reaction_1_description,

    upper(
        json_extract_string(a.resource, '$.reaction[0].severity')
    )::VARCHAR AS reaction_1_severity,

    json_extract_string(
        a.resource, '$.reaction[1].manifestation[0].coding[0].code'
    )::VARCHAR AS reaction_2_code,

    coalesce(
        json_extract_string(
            a.resource, '$.reaction[1].manifestation[0].coding[0].display'
        ),
        json_extract_string(
            a.resource, '$.reaction[1].manifestation[0].text'
        )
    )::VARCHAR AS reaction_2_description,

    upper(
        json_extract_string(a.resource, '$.reaction[1].severity')
    )::VARCHAR AS reaction_2_severity

FROM allergies AS a
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    -- When context is absent, use the encounter containing the assertion.
    -- Limit deterministically so overlapping encounters cannot multiply rows.
    SELECT e.encounter_id
    FROM encounters AS e
    WHERE a.explicit_encounter_id IS NULL
      AND e.patient_id = a.patient_id
      AND a.asserted_at >= e.start_at
      AND a.asserted_at <= coalesce(e.end_at, e.start_at)
    ORDER BY
        CASE WHEN a.asserted_at = e.start_at THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,
        e.start_at DESC,
        e.encounter_id
    LIMIT 1
) AS matched ON TRUE

with src as (

    select
        id,
        resource
    from {{ source('raw_fhir_stu3', 'observation') }}
    where json_extract_string(resource, '$.resourceType') = 'Observation'

),

-- Observations without components: the resource itself carries code and value.
-- Observations with components (blood pressure, survey panels): the acquirer's
-- rows are one per component, so each component becomes its own row.
items as (

    select
        resource,
        resource as item
    from src
    where coalesce(json_array_length(json_extract(resource, '$.component')), 0) = 0

    union all

    select
        s.resource,
        u.item
    from src s,
         unnest(from_json(json_extract(s.resource, '$.component'), '["JSON"]')) as u(item)
    where coalesce(json_array_length(json_extract(s.resource, '$.component')), 0) > 0

),

extracted as (

    select
        cast(json_extract_string(resource, '$.effectiveDateTime') as timestamptz) as effective_ts,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.subject.reference') as subject_ref,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.context.reference') as context_ref,
        json_extract_string(resource, '$.category[0].coding[0].code') as category_code,
        json_extract_string(item, '$.code.coding[0].code') as code_value,
        coalesce(
            json_extract_string(item, '$.code.coding[0].display'),
            json_extract_string(item, '$.code.text')
        ) as code_display,
        json_extract_string(item, '$.valueQuantity.value') as quantity_value,
        json_extract_string(item, '$.valueQuantity.unit') as quantity_unit,
        coalesce(
            json_extract_string(item, '$.valueCodeableConcept.text'),
            json_extract_string(item, '$.valueCodeableConcept.coding[0].display'),
            json_extract_string(item, '$.valueString')
        ) as text_value
    from items

)

select
    cast(timezone('UTC', effective_ts) as timestamp) as observation_datetime,
    cast(cast(timezone('UTC', effective_ts) as timestamp) as date) as observation_date,
    cast(regexp_replace(subject_ref, '^.*[:/]', '') as varchar) as patient_id,

    cast(quantity_unit as varchar) as observation_units,
    cast(case when quantity_value is not null then 'numeric' else 'text' end as varchar) as observation_value_type
from extracted

        WHEN 'http://snomed.info/sct' THEN 'SNOMED-CT'

        ELSE json_extract_string(a.resource, '$.code.coding[0].system')

    FROM {{ source('raw_claims', 'members') }}
),
states AS (

    NULL::VARCHAR AS patient_suffix,

WITH base AS (

    SELECT
        id
        , resource
    FROM {{ source('raw_fhir_stu3', 'observation') }}
    WHERE resource->>'$.resourceType' = 'Observation'

)

, items AS (

    -- observations without components: one row, the item is the resource itself
    SELECT
        id
        , resource AS parent
        , resource AS item
    FROM base
    WHERE coalesce(json_array_length(resource->'$.component'), 0) = 0

    UNION ALL

    -- observations with components: one row per component
    SELECT
        id
        , resource AS parent
        , unnest(CAST(resource->'$.component' AS JSON[])) AS item
    FROM base
    WHERE coalesce(json_array_length(resource->'$.component'), 0) > 0

)

, cte_fields AS (

    SELECT
        (CAST(parent->>'$.effectiveDateTime' AS TIMESTAMPTZ) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS observation_datetime
        , replace(parent->>'$.subject.reference', 'urn:uuid:', '') AS patient_id
        , replace(
            coalesce(parent->>'$.context.reference', parent->>'$.encounter.reference')
            , 'urn:uuid:', ''
        ) AS encounter_id
        , parent->>'$.category[0].coding[0].code' AS observation_category
        , item->>'$.code.coding[0].code' AS observation_code
        , replace(item->>'$.code.coding[0].display', ',', ' ') AS observation_description
        , (item->'$.valueQuantity') IS NOT NULL AS is_quantity
        , item->>'$.valueQuantity.value' AS quantity_value
        , item->>'$.valueQuantity.unit' AS quantity_unit
        , coalesce(
            item->>'$.valueCodeableConcept.coding[0].display'
            , item->>'$.valueString'
        ) AS text_value
    FROM items

)

SELECT
    CAST(observation_datetime AS TIMESTAMP) AS observation_datetime
    , CAST(observation_datetime AS DATE) AS observation_date
    , CAST(patient_id AS VARCHAR) AS patient_id
    , CAST(encounter_id AS VARCHAR) AS encounter_id
    , CAST(observation_category AS VARCHAR) AS observation_category
    , CAST(observation_code AS VARCHAR) AS observation_code
    , CAST(observation_description AS VARCHAR) AS observation_description
    , CAST(
        CASE
            WHEN is_quantity THEN
                CAST(
                    ROUND(CAST(quantity_value AS DECIMAL(28, 6)), 1)
                    AS DECIMAL(28, 1)
                )::VARCHAR
            ELSE replace(text_value, ',', ' ')
        END AS VARCHAR
    ) AS observation_value
    , CAST(
        CASE WHEN is_quantity THEN replace(quantity_unit, ',', ' ') ELSE NULL END
        AS VARCHAR
    ) AS observation_units
    , CAST(
        CASE
            WHEN is_quantity THEN 'numeric'
            WHEN text_value IS NOT NULL THEN 'text'
            ELSE NULL
        END AS VARCHAR
    ) AS observation_value_type
FROM cte_fields

WITH medications AS (
    SELECT
        TRY_CAST(NULLIF(TRIM("Service (from) date"), '') AS DATE) AS start_date,
        TRY_CAST(NULLIF(TRIM("Service to date"), '') AS DATE) AS stop_date,
        NULLIF(TRIM("Patient account number"), '') AS patient_id,
        NULLIF(TRIM("Claim payer identifier"), '') AS payer_id,
        NULLIF(TRIM("Medical record number"), '') AS encounter_id,
        NULLIF(TRIM("National drug code"), '') AS medication_code,
        TRY_CAST(NULLIF(TRIM("Drug cost"), '') AS FLOAT) AS medication_base_cost,
        TRY_CAST(NULLIF(TRIM("Line primary payer paid amount"), '') AS FLOAT)
            AS medication_payer_coverage,
        TRY_CAST(NULLIF(TRIM("Quantity dispensed"), '') AS FLOAT) AS dispenses,
        TRY_CAST(NULLIF(TRIM("Line submitted amount"), '') AS FLOAT)
            AS medication_total_cost,
        CASE
            WHEN UPPER(TRIM("Diagnosis code type")) IN ('SNOMED', 'SNOMED-CT', 'SNOMED CT')
                THEN NULLIF(TRIM("Diagnosis code"), '')
        END AS medication_reason_code,
        CASE
            WHEN UPPER(TRIM("Diagnosis code type")) IN ('SNOMED', 'SNOMED-CT', 'SNOMED CT')
                THEN NULLIF(TRIM("Diagnosis description"), '')
        END AS medication_reason_description
    FROM {{ source('raw_claims', 'claims') }}
    WHERE NULLIF(TRIM("National drug code"), '') IS NOT NULL
)

SELECT

    medication_base_cost,
    medication_payer_coverage,
    dispenses,
    medication_total_cost,
    medication_reason_code,
    medication_reason_description
FROM medications

WITH src AS (
    SELECT
        lower(trim("Member id")) AS member_id
        , try_cast(nullif(trim("Date of birth"), '') AS DATE) AS dob
        , try_cast(nullif(trim("Date of death"), '') AS DATE) AS dod
        , nullif(trim("Home_County"), '') AS home_county
        , nullif(trim("Home_State"), '') AS home_state
        , nullif(trim("Home_Zip code"), '') AS home_zip
        , lower(nullif(trim("Race code"), '')) AS race
        , lower(nullif(trim("Ethnicity"), '')) AS ethnicity
        , upper(nullif(trim("Gender code"), '')) AS gender
        , nullif(trim("Name"), '') AS full_name
        , row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY lower(trim("Member id")) ORDER BY "Member id") AS rn
    FROM {{ source('raw_claims', 'members') }}
    WHERE nullif(trim("Member id"), '') IS NOT NULL
)

, dedup AS (
    SELECT * FROM src WHERE rn = 1
)

, named AS (
    SELECT
        d.*
        , regexp_extract(d.full_name, '^(Mr\.|Mrs\.|Ms\.|Miss|Dr\.)\s+', 1) AS name_prefix
        , regexp_replace(d.full_name, '^(Mr\.|Mrs\.|Ms\.|Miss|Dr\.)\s+', '') AS name_rest
    FROM dedup AS d
)

SELECT
    n.member_id AS patient_id
    , n.dob AS birth_date
    , n.dod AS death_date
    , CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS ssn
    , CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS drivers_license_number
    , CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS passport_number
    , nullif(n.name_prefix, '') AS patient_prefix
    , nullif(split_part(n.name_rest, ' ', 1), '') AS patient_first_name
    , nullif(trim(substr(n.name_rest, length(split_part(n.name_rest, ' ', 1)) + 1)), '') AS patient_last_name
    , CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS patient_suffix
    , CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS maiden_name
    , CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS marital_status
    , n.race AS race
    , n.ethnicity AS ethnicity
    , n.gender AS patient_gender
    , CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS birthplace
    , CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS patient_address
    , CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS patient_city
    , coalesce(s1.state_name, s2.state_name, n.home_state) AS patient_state
    , n.home_county AS patient_county
    , n.home_zip AS patient_zip
    , CAST(NULL AS FLOAT) AS patient_latitude
    , CAST(NULL AS FLOAT) AS patient_longitude
    , CAST(NULL AS FLOAT) AS healthcare_expenses
    , CAST(NULL AS FLOAT) AS healthcare_coverage
FROM named AS n
LEFT JOIN {{ ref('stg_map__states') }} AS s1
    ON lower(n.home_state) = lower(s1.state_abbreviation)
LEFT JOIN {{ ref('stg_map__states') }} AS s2
    ON lower(n.home_state) = lower(s2.state_name)

WITH medication_lines AS (
    SELECT
        TRY_CAST(NULLIF(TRIM("Service (from) date"), '') AS DATE) AS start_date,
        TRY_CAST(NULLIF(TRIM("Service to date"), '') AS DATE) AS stop_date,
        LOWER(NULLIF(TRIM("Patient account number"), '')) AS patient_id,
        LOWER(NULLIF(TRIM("Claim payer identifier"), '')) AS payer_id,
        LOWER(NULLIF(TRIM("Medical record number"), '')) AS encounter_id,
        NULLIF(TRIM("National drug code"), '') AS medication_code,
        TRY_CAST(NULLIF(TRIM("Drug cost"), '') AS FLOAT) AS medication_base_cost,
        TRY_CAST(
            NULLIF(TRIM("Line primary payer paid amount"), '') AS FLOAT
        ) AS medication_payer_coverage,
        TRY_CAST(
            NULLIF(TRIM("Line submitted amount"), '') AS FLOAT
        ) AS medication_total_cost,
        CASE
            WHEN UPPER(TRIM("Diagnosis code type")) IN (
                'SNOMED', 'SNOMED-CT', 'SNOMED CT'
            )
            THEN NULLIF(TRIM("Diagnosis code"), '')
        END AS medication_reason_code,
        CASE
            WHEN UPPER(TRIM("Diagnosis code type")) IN (
                'SNOMED', 'SNOMED-CT', 'SNOMED CT'
            )
            THEN NULLIF(TRIM("Diagnosis description"), '')
        END AS medication_reason_description
    FROM {{ source('raw_claims', 'claims') }}
    WHERE NULLIF(TRIM("National drug code"), '') IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
    -- Date-only service values are represented at midnight UTC.
    CAST(start_date AS TIMESTAMP) AS medication_start_datetime,
    CAST(start_date AS DATE) AS medication_start_date,
    CAST(stop_date AS TIMESTAMP) AS medication_stop_datetime,
    CAST(stop_date AS DATE) AS medication_stop_date,
    CAST(patient_id AS VARCHAR) AS patient_id,
    CAST(payer_id AS VARCHAR) AS payer_id,
    CAST(encounter_id AS VARCHAR) AS encounter_id,
    -- Preserve the supplied code; no drug terminology crosswalk is available.
    CAST(medication_code AS VARCHAR) AS medication_code,
    CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS medication_description,
    CAST(medication_base_cost AS FLOAT) AS medication_base_cost,
    CAST(medication_payer_coverage AS FLOAT) AS medication_payer_coverage,
    -- Each medication claim line represents one dispensing, not a unit quantity.
    CAST(1 AS FLOAT) AS dispenses,
    CAST(medication_total_cost AS FLOAT) AS medication_total_cost,
    CAST(medication_reason_code AS VARCHAR) AS medication_reason_code,
    CAST(medication_reason_description AS VARCHAR) AS medication_reason_description
FROM medication_lines

        TRY_CAST(NULLIF(TRIM("Service (from) date"), '') AS DATE) AS start_date,
        NULLIF(
            TRY_CAST(NULLIF(TRIM("Service to date"), '') AS DATE),
            DATE '1969-12-31'
        ) AS stop_date,
        NULLIF(TRIM("Patient account number"), '') AS patient_id,
        NULLIF(TRIM("National drug code"), '') AS medication_code,
        TRY_CAST(NULLIF(TRIM("Drug cost"), '') AS FLOAT) AS medication_base_cost,
        TRY_CAST(NULLIF(TRIM("Line primary payer paid amount"), '') AS FLOAT)
            AS medication_payer_coverage,
        TRY_CAST(NULLIF(TRIM("Quantity dispensed"), '') AS FLOAT) AS dispenses,
        TRY_CAST(NULLIF(TRIM("Line submitted amount"), '') AS FLOAT)
            AS medication_total_cost,
        NULLIF(TRIM("Diagnosis code"), '') AS medication_reason_code,
        NULLIF(TRIM("Diagnosis description"), '') AS medication_reason_description
    FROM {{ source('raw_claims', 'claims') }}
    WHERE NULLIF(TRIM("National drug code"), '') IS NOT NULL
)

        , nullif(trim("Name"), '') AS name_raw

        , try_cast(try_strptime(s.dob_raw, '%Y/%m/%d') AS DATE)

    , coalesce(

        , try_cast(try_strptime(s.dod_raw, '%m/%d/%Y') AS DATE)
        , try_cast(try_strptime(s.dod_raw, '%Y/%m/%d') AS DATE)

    , CASE

        ELSE split_part(s.name_raw, ' ', 1)
    END::VARCHAR AS patient_first_name
    , CASE
        WHEN s.name_raw IS NULL OR strpos(s.name_raw, ' ') = 0 THEN NULL
        ELSE nullif(trim(substr(s.name_raw, strpos(s.name_raw, ' ') + 1)), '')
    END::VARCHAR AS patient_last_name
    , CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS patient_suffix
    , CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS maiden_name
    , CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS marital_status
    , lower(s.race_raw)::VARCHAR AS race
    , lower(s.ethnicity_raw)::VARCHAR AS ethnicity
    , CASE
        WHEN upper(left(coalesce(s.gender_raw, s.birth_sex_raw), 1)) IN ('M', 'F')
            THEN upper(left(coalesce(s.gender_raw, s.birth_sex_raw), 1))
        ELSE NULL
    END::VARCHAR AS patient_gender
    , CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS birthplace
    , CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS patient_address
    , CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS patient_city

    , s.county_raw::VARCHAR AS patient_county
    , CASE

        ELSE s.zip_raw
    END::VARCHAR AS patient_zip
    , CAST(NULL AS FLOAT) AS patient_latitude
    , CAST(NULL AS FLOAT) AS patient_longitude
    , CAST(NULL AS FLOAT) AS healthcare_expenses
    , CAST(NULL AS FLOAT) AS healthcare_coverage
FROM src AS s
LEFT JOIN states_dedup AS st
    ON lower(s.state_raw) = st.state_key
WHERE s.rn = 1

    , CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS passport_number
    , CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS patient_prefix
    , nullif(p.first_name_p, '') AS patient_first_name
    , nullif(p.last_name_p, '') AS patient_last_name
    , CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS patient_suffix
    , CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS maiden_name
    , CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS marital_status
    , lower(p.race_raw) AS race
    , lower(p.ethnicity_raw) AS ethnicity
    , CASE
        WHEN p.gender_up IN ('F', 'FEMALE') THEN 'F'
        WHEN p.gender_up IN ('M', 'MALE') THEN 'M'

    END AS patient_gender
    , CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS birthplace
    , CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS patient_address
    , CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS patient_city
    , coalesce(s.state_name, p.state_raw) AS patient_state
    , p.county_raw AS patient_county
    , CASE

    , CAST(NULL AS FLOAT) AS patient_latitude
    , CAST(NULL AS FLOAT) AS patient_longitude
    , CAST(NULL AS FLOAT) AS healthcare_expenses
    , CAST(NULL AS FLOAT) AS healthcare_coverage

LEFT JOIN states AS s

        , NULLIF(TRIM("Gender code"), '') AS gender_code
        , NULLIF(TRIM("Birth sex"), '') AS birth_sex
        , NULLIF(TRIM("Name"), '') AS full_name
        , ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY NULLIF(TRIM("Member id"), '')
            ORDER BY "Date of death" NULLS LAST, "Date of birth"
        ) AS rn
    FROM {{ source('raw_claims', 'members') }}

)

    FROM src
    WHERE rn = 1

WITH diagnoses AS (

    SELECT
        CAST(substr(trim("Service (from) date"), 1, 10) AS DATE) AS condition_start_date
        , CAST(substr(trim("Service to date"), 1, 10) AS DATE) AS stop_raw
        , lower(trim("Patient account number")) AS patient_id
        , trim("Diagnosis code") AS condition_code
        , trim("Diagnosis description") AS condition_description
    FROM {{ source('raw_claims', 'claims') }}
    WHERE nullif(trim("Diagnosis code"), '') IS NOT NULL

)

, deduplicated AS (

    SELECT
        condition_start_date
        , CASE
            WHEN stop_raw = DATE '1969-12-31' THEN NULL
            ELSE stop_raw
        END AS condition_stop_date
        , patient_id
        , condition_code
        , min(condition_description) AS condition_description
    FROM diagnoses
    GROUP BY
        condition_start_date
        , stop_raw
        , patient_id
        , condition_code

-- Conditions are taken from the claim lines that carry a diagnosis.
-- Mapping:
--   patient_id         <- "Patient account number"
--   encounter_id       <- "Medical record number" (differs per claim, so it is the encounter id)
--   condition_code     <- "Diagnosis code"
--   condition_start_date <- "Claim service start date"
-- The export has no resolution date, so condition_stop_date is NULL.
-- Claim lines that repeat the same diagnosis within an encounter are collapsed to one row.
with src as (

    select
        try_cast(nullif(trim("Claim service start date"), '') as date) as condition_start_date,
        cast(null as date) as condition_stop_date,
        lower(trim("Patient account number")) as patient_id,
        lower(trim("Medical record number")) as encounter_id,
        trim("Diagnosis code") as condition_code,
        trim("Diagnosis description") as condition_description
    from {{ source('raw_claims', 'claims') }}
    where nullif(trim("Diagnosis code"), '') is not null

),

dedup as (

    select
        *,
        row_number() over (
            partition by patient_id, encounter_id, condition_code, condition_start_date
            order by condition_description
        ) as rn
    from src

)

select
    cast(condition_start_date as date) as condition_start_date,
    cast(condition_stop_date as date) as condition_stop_date,
    cast(patient_id as varchar) as patient_id,
    cast(encounter_id as varchar) as encounter_id,
    cast(condition_code as varchar) as condition_code,
    cast(condition_description as varchar) as condition_description
from dedup
where rn = 1

        ELSE s.ssn_raw

I made two assumptions that the sample data could not confirm:

- **Identifiers:** I lowercased and trimmed `patient_id` and `encounter_id` to match the acquirer's lowercase UUIDs.
- **Descriptions:** I only trimmed them, and did not map them to the acquirer's wording. One sample label, "Acute allergic reaction" for code 10509002, may differ from the acquirer's own description for that code. I cannot check that without reading the acquirer's tables, which the rules forbid.

WITH observations AS (
    SELECT
        strptime(
            date_date || ' ' || date_time,
            '%m/%d/%Y %H:%M:%S'
        ) AS observation_datetime,
        CAST(patient AS VARCHAR) AS patient_id,
        CAST(encounter AS VARCHAR) AS encounter_id,
        CAST(category AS VARCHAR) AS observation_category,
        CAST(
            CASE
                WHEN strpos(code_display, ' | ') > 0
                    THEN substr(code_display, 1, strpos(code_display, ' | ') - 1)
                ELSE code_display
            END AS VARCHAR
        ) AS observation_code,
        CAST(
            CASE
                WHEN strpos(code_display, ' | ') > 0
                    THEN substr(code_display, strpos(code_display, ' | ') + 3)
                ELSE NULL
            END AS VARCHAR
        ) AS observation_description,
        CAST("value" AS VARCHAR) AS observation_value,
        CAST(units AS VARCHAR) AS observation_units,
        CAST("type" AS VARCHAR) AS observation_value_type
    FROM {{ source('raw_d2', 'observations') }}
)

WITH src AS (

    SELECT
        lower(trim(id)) AS patient_id
        , try_strptime(nullif(trim(birthdate), ''), '%d-%b-%Y')::DATE AS birth_date
        , try_strptime(nullif(trim(deathdate), ''), '%d-%b-%Y')::DATE AS death_date
        , nullif(trim(ssn), '') AS ssn
        , nullif(trim(drivers), '') AS drivers_license_number
        , nullif(trim(passport), '') AS passport_number
        , nullif(trim(prefix), '') AS patient_prefix
        , nullif(trim(split_part(full_name, ',', 2)), '') AS patient_first_name
        , nullif(trim(split_part(full_name, ',', 1)), '') AS patient_last_name
        , nullif(trim(suffix), '') AS patient_suffix
        , nullif(trim(maiden), '') AS maiden_name
        , nullif(upper(trim(marital)), '') AS marital_status
        , nullif(lower(trim(race)), '') AS race
        , nullif(lower(trim(ethnicity)), '') AS ethnicity
        , nullif(upper(trim(gender)), '') AS patient_gender
        , nullif(trim(birthplace), '') AS birthplace
        , nullif(trim(address), '') AS patient_address
        , nullif(trim(split_part(city_state_zip, ',', 1)), '') AS patient_city
        , trim(substr(city_state_zip, strpos(city_state_zip, ',') + 1)) AS state_zip
        , nullif(trim(county), '') AS patient_county
        , CAST(lat AS FLOAT) AS patient_latitude
        , CAST(lon AS FLOAT) AS patient_longitude
        , CAST(healthcare_expenses AS FLOAT) AS healthcare_expenses
        , CAST(healthcare_coverage AS FLOAT) AS healthcare_coverage
    FROM {{ source('raw_d2', 'patients') }}

)

, parsed AS (

    SELECT
        *
        , nullif(trim(regexp_replace(state_zip, '\s*[0-9]{5}(-[0-9]{4})?$', '')), '') AS state_raw
        , nullif(regexp_extract(state_zip, '([0-9]{5})(-[0-9]{4})?$', 1), '') AS patient_zip
    FROM src

)

, state_lookup AS (

    SELECT DISTINCT lower(state_abbreviation) AS k, state_name

WITH cte_enc AS (

    SELECT
        trim(id) AS encounter_id
        , strptime(trim(start_date) || ' ' || trim(start_time), '%m/%d/%Y %H:%M:%S') AS start_dt
        , CASE
            WHEN nullif(trim(stop_date), '') IS NOT NULL AND nullif(trim(stop_time), '') IS NOT NULL
            THEN strptime(trim(stop_date) || ' ' || trim(stop_time), '%m/%d/%Y %H:%M:%S')
          END AS stop_dt
        , trim(patient) AS patient_id
        , trim(organization) AS organization_id
        , trim(provider) AS provider_id
        , trim(payer) AS payer_id
        , trim(encounterclass) AS encounter_class
        , nullif(trim(code_display), '') AS code_display
        , nullif(trim(reason), '') AS reason
    FROM {{ source('raw_d2', 'encounters') }}

)

, cte_charges AS (

    SELECT
        trim(encounter_id) AS encounter_id
        , base_encounter_cost
        , total_claim_cost
        , payer_coverage
    FROM {{ source('raw_d2', 'encounter_charges') }}

)

, cte_final AS (

    SELECT
        e.encounter_id
        , CAST(e.start_dt AS TIMESTAMP) AS encounter_start_datetime
        , CAST(e.start_dt AS DATE) AS encounter_start_date
        , CAST(COALESCE(e.stop_dt, e.start_dt) AS TIMESTAMP) AS encounter_stop_datetime
        -- same convention as the acquirer's staging: start date takes precedence
        , COALESCE(CAST(e.start_dt AS DATE), CAST(COALESCE(e.stop_dt, e.start_dt) AS DATE)) AS encounter_stop_date
        , e.patient_id
        , e.organization_id
        , e.provider_id
        , e.payer_id
        , e.encounter_class
        , CASE
            WHEN strpos(e.code_display, ' | ') > 0
            THEN trim(substr(e.code_display, 1, strpos(e.code_display, ' | ') - 1))
            ELSE e.code_display
          END AS encounter_code
        , CASE
            WHEN strpos(e.code_display, ' | ') > 0
            THEN trim(substr(e.code_display, strpos(e.code_display, ' | ') + 3))
          END AS encounter_description
        , CAST(c.base_encounter_cost AS FLOAT) AS base_encounter_cost
        , CAST(c.total_claim_cost AS FLOAT) AS total_encounter_cost
        , CAST(c.payer_coverage AS FLOAT) AS encounter_payer_coverage
        , CASE
            WHEN strpos(e.reason, ' | ') > 0
            THEN trim(substr(e.reason, 1, strpos(e.reason, ' | ') - 1))
            ELSE e.reason
          END AS encounter_reason_code
        , CASE
            WHEN strpos(e.reason, ' | ') > 0
            THEN trim(substr(e.reason, strpos(e.reason, ' | ') + 3))
          END AS encounter_reason_description
    FROM cte_enc AS e
    LEFT JOIN cte_charges AS c
        ON e.encounter_id = c.encounter_id

)

SELECT *
FROM cte_final

WITH cte_enc AS (

    SELECT
        lower(trim(e."id")) AS encounter_id
        , strptime(trim(e."start_date") || ' ' || trim(e."start_time"), '%m/%d/%Y %H:%M:%S') AS start_dt
        , strptime(trim(e."stop_date") || ' ' || trim(e."stop_time"), '%m/%d/%Y %H:%M:%S') AS stop_dt
        , lower(trim(e."patient")) AS patient_id
        , lower(trim(e."organization")) AS organization_id
        , lower(trim(e."provider")) AS provider_id
        , lower(trim(e."payer")) AS payer_id
        , e."encounterclass" AS encounter_class
        , e."code_display" AS code_display
        , NULLIF(trim(e."reason"), '') AS reason
    FROM {{ source('raw_d2', 'encounters') }} AS e

)

, cte_charges AS (

    SELECT
        lower(trim("encounter_id")) AS encounter_id
        , "base_encounter_cost" AS base_encounter_cost
        , "total_claim_cost" AS total_claim_cost
        , "payer_coverage" AS payer_coverage
    FROM {{ source('raw_d2', 'encounter_charges') }}

)

, cte_joined AS (

    SELECT
        e.encounter_id
        , e.start_dt AS encounter_start_datetime
        , COALESCE(e.stop_dt, e.start_dt) AS encounter_stop_datetime
        , e.patient_id
        , e.organization_id
        , e.provider_id
        , e.payer_id
        , e.encounter_class
        , CASE WHEN strpos(e.code_display, ' | ') > 0
               THEN substr(e.code_display, 1, strpos(e.code_display, ' | ') - 1)
               ELSE e.code_display END AS encounter_code
        , CASE WHEN strpos(e.code_display, ' | ') > 0
               THEN substr(e.code_display, strpos(e.code_display, ' | ') + 3)
               ELSE NULL END AS encounter_description
        , c.base_encounter_cost
        , c.total_claim_cost AS total_encounter_cost
        , c.payer_coverage AS encounter_payer_coverage
        , CASE WHEN e.reason IS NULL THEN NULL
               WHEN strpos(e.reason, ' | ') > 0
               THEN substr(e.reason, 1, strpos(e.reason, ' | ') - 1)
               ELSE e.reason END AS encounter_reason_code
        , CASE WHEN e.reason IS NULL THEN NULL
               WHEN strpos(e.reason, ' | ') > 0
               THEN substr(e.reason, strpos(e.reason, ' | ') + 3)
               ELSE NULL END AS encounter_reason_description
    FROM cte_enc AS e
    LEFT JOIN cte_charges AS c

)

        , try_strptime(trim("stop_date") || ' ' || trim("stop_time"), '%m/%d/%Y %H:%M:%S') AS procedure_stop_datetime
        , lower(trim("patient")) AS patient_id
        , lower(trim("encounter")) AS encounter_id
        , trim("code_display") AS code_display
        , "base_cost" AS base_cost
        , NULLIF(trim("reason"), '') AS reason
    FROM {{ source('raw_d2', 'procedures') }}

SELECT
    CAST(procedure_start_datetime AS TIMESTAMP) AS procedure_start_datetime
    , CAST(procedure_start_datetime AS DATE) AS procedure_start_date
    , CAST(procedure_stop_datetime AS TIMESTAMP) AS procedure_stop_datetime
    , CAST(procedure_stop_datetime AS DATE) AS procedure_stop_date
    , CAST(patient_id AS VARCHAR) AS patient_id
    , CAST(encounter_id AS VARCHAR) AS encounter_id
    , CAST(
        CASE
            WHEN strpos(code_display, ' | ') > 0
                THEN trim(substr(code_display, 1, strpos(code_display, ' | ') - 1))
            ELSE NULLIF(code_display, '')
        END AS VARCHAR
    ) AS procedure_code
    , CAST(
        CASE
            WHEN strpos(code_display, ' | ') > 0
                THEN trim(substr(code_display, strpos(code_display, ' | ') + 3))
            ELSE NULL
        END AS VARCHAR
    ) AS procedure_description

    , CAST(
        CASE
            WHEN reason IS NULL THEN NULL
            WHEN strpos(reason, ' | ') > 0
                THEN trim(substr(reason, 1, strpos(reason, ' | ') - 1))
            ELSE reason
        END AS VARCHAR

    , CAST(
        CASE
            WHEN reason IS NOT NULL AND strpos(reason, ' | ') > 0
                THEN trim(substr(reason, strpos(reason, ' | ') + 3))
            ELSE NULL
        END AS VARCHAR
    ) AS procedure_reason_description
FROM src

        , trim(start_time) AS start_time
        , trim(stop_date) AS stop_date
        , trim(stop_time) AS stop_time
        , lower(trim(patient)) AS patient

    FROM {{ source('raw_d2', 'procedures') }}

)

, parsed AS (

    SELECT
        CAST(
            COALESCE(
                try_strptime(start_date, '%m/%d/%Y')
                , try_strptime(start_date, '%d-%b-%Y')
            ) AS DATE
        ) AS s_date
        , CAST(start_time AS TIME) AS s_time
        , CAST(
            COALESCE(
                try_strptime(stop_date, '%m/%d/%Y')
                , try_strptime(stop_date, '%d-%b-%Y')

    SELECT
        NULLIF(TRIM("start_date"), '') AS start_date
        , NULLIF(TRIM("start_time"), '') AS start_time
        , NULLIF(TRIM("stop_date"), '') AS stop_date
        , NULLIF(TRIM("stop_time"), '') AS stop_time
        , NULLIF(LOWER(TRIM("patient")), '') AS patient_id
        , NULLIF(LOWER(TRIM("payer")), '') AS payer_id
        , NULLIF(LOWER(TRIM("encounter")), '') AS encounter_id
        , NULLIF(TRIM("code_display"), '') AS code_display
        , "base_cost"
        , "payer_coverage"
        , "dispenses"
        , "totalcost"
        , NULLIF(TRIM("reason"), '') AS reason
    FROM {{ source('raw_d2', 'medications') }}

)

, parsed AS (

    SELECT
        TRY_STRPTIME(start_date || ' ' || COALESCE(start_time, '00:00:00'), '%m/%d/%Y %H:%M:%S') AS medication_start_datetime
        , TRY_STRPTIME(stop_date || ' ' || COALESCE(stop_time, '00:00:00'), '%m/%d/%Y %H:%M:%S') AS medication_stop_datetime
        , patient_id
        , payer_id
        , encounter_id
        , CASE
            WHEN code_display IS NULL THEN NULL
            WHEN POSITION(' | ' IN code_display) > 0
                THEN NULLIF(TRIM(SUBSTR(code_display, 1, POSITION(' | ' IN code_display) - 1)), '')
            ELSE code_display
          END AS medication_code
        , CASE
            WHEN code_display IS NULL THEN NULL
            WHEN POSITION(' | ' IN code_display) > 0
                THEN NULLIF(TRIM(SUBSTR(code_display, POSITION(' | ' IN code_display) + 3)), '')
            ELSE NULL
          END AS medication_description
        , base_cost
        , payer_coverage
        , dispenses
        , totalcost
        , CASE
            WHEN reason IS NULL THEN NULL
            WHEN POSITION(' | ' IN reason) > 0
                THEN NULLIF(TRIM(SUBSTR(reason, 1, POSITION(' | ' IN reason) - 1)), '')
            ELSE reason
          END AS medication_reason_code
        , CASE
            WHEN reason IS NULL THEN NULL
            WHEN POSITION(' | ' IN reason) > 0
                THEN NULLIF(TRIM(SUBSTR(reason, POSITION(' | ' IN reason) + 3)), '')
            ELSE NULL
          END AS medication_reason_description
    FROM src

)

SELECT
    CAST(medication_start_datetime AS TIMESTAMP) AS medication_start_datetime
    , CAST(medication_start_datetime AS DATE) AS medication_start_date
    , CAST(medication_stop_datetime AS TIMESTAMP) AS medication_stop_datetime
    , CAST(medication_stop_datetime AS DATE) AS medication_stop_date
    , CAST(patient_id AS VARCHAR) AS patient_id

    , CAST(base_cost AS FLOAT) AS medication_base_cost
    , CAST(payer_coverage AS FLOAT) AS medication_payer_coverage

    , CAST(medication_reason_code AS VARCHAR) AS medication_reason_code
    , CAST(medication_reason_description AS VARCHAR) AS medication_reason_description

select
    p.person_id
    , coalesce(sum(case when pp.plan_source_value = 'Aetna' then datediff('month', pp.payer_plan_period_start_date, pp.payer_plan_period_end_date) end), 0) as months_aetna
    , coalesce(sum(case when pp.plan_source_value = 'Anthem' then datediff('month', pp.payer_plan_period_start_date, pp.payer_plan_period_end_date) end), 0) as months_anthem
    , coalesce(sum(case when pp.plan_source_value = 'Blue Cross Blue Shield' then datediff('month', pp.payer_plan_period_start_date, pp.payer_plan_period_end_date) end), 0) as months_blue_cross_blue_shield
    , coalesce(sum(case when pp.plan_source_value = 'Cigna Health' then datediff('month', pp.payer_plan_period_start_date, pp.payer_plan_period_end_date) end), 0) as months_cigna_health
    , coalesce(sum(case when pp.plan_source_value = 'Dual Eligible' then datediff('month', pp.payer_plan_period_start_date, pp.payer_plan_period_end_date) end), 0) as months_dual_eligible
    , coalesce(sum(case when pp.plan_source_value = 'Humana' then datediff('month', pp.payer_plan_period_start_date, pp.payer_plan_period_end_date) end), 0) as months_humana
    , coalesce(sum(case when pp.plan_source_value = 'Medicaid' then datediff('month', pp.payer_plan_period_start_date, pp.payer_plan_period_end_date) end), 0) as months_medicaid
    , coalesce(sum(case when pp.plan_source_value = 'Medicare' then datediff('month', pp.payer_plan_period_start_date, pp.payer_plan_period_end_date) end), 0) as months_medicare
    , coalesce(sum(case when pp.plan_source_value = 'NO_INSURANCE' then datediff('month', pp.payer_plan_period_start_date, pp.payer_plan_period_end_date) end), 0) as months_no_insurance
    , coalesce(sum(case when pp.plan_source_value = 'UnitedHealthcare' then datediff('month', pp.payer_plan_period_start_date, pp.payer_plan_period_end_date) end), 0) as months_unitedhealthcare
from {{ ref('person') }} as p
left join {{ ref('payer_plan_period') }} as pp
    on pp.person_id = p.person_id
group by p.person_id

WITH src AS (

    SELECT
        trim(date_date) AS d
        , trim(date_time) AS t
        , lower(trim(patient)) AS patient_id
        , lower(nullif(trim(encounter), '')) AS encounter_id
        , lower(nullif(trim(category), '')) AS observation_category
        , trim(code_display) AS code_display
        , nullif(trim("value"), '') AS observation_value
        , nullif(trim(units), '') AS observation_units
        , lower(nullif(trim("type"), '')) AS observation_value_type
    FROM {{ source('raw_d2', 'observations') }}

)

, fmt AS (

    -- the day/month order is not stated, so it is detected from the data itself
    SELECT
        CASE
            WHEN max(CASE WHEN try_cast(split_part(d, '/', 2) AS INTEGER) > 12 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 1 THEN 'mdy'
            WHEN max(CASE WHEN try_cast(split_part(d, '/', 1) AS INTEGER) > 12 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 1 THEN 'dmy'
            ELSE 'mdy'
        END AS date_order
    FROM src

)

, parsed AS (

    SELECT
        CAST(
            CASE
                WHEN fmt.date_order = 'dmy'
                    THEN try_strptime(src.d || ' ' || src.t, '%d/%m/%Y %H:%M:%S')
                ELSE try_strptime(src.d || ' ' || src.t, '%m/%d/%Y %H:%M:%S')
            END AS TIMESTAMP
        ) AS observation_datetime
        , src.patient_id
        , src.encounter_id
        , src.observation_category
        , nullif(trim(split_part(src.code_display, ' | ', 1)), '') AS observation_code
        , CASE
            WHEN position(' | ' IN src.code_display) > 0
                THEN nullif(trim(substr(src.code_display, position(' | ' IN src.code_display) + 3)), '')
            ELSE NULL
        END AS observation_description
        , src.observation_value
        , src.observation_units
        , src.observation_value_type
    FROM src
    CROSS JOIN fmt

)

SELECT
    observation_datetime
    , CAST(observation_datetime AS DATE) AS observation_date
    , CAST(patient_id AS VARCHAR) AS patient_id
    , CAST(encounter_id AS VARCHAR) AS encounter_id
    , CAST(observation_category AS VARCHAR) AS observation_category
    , CAST(observation_code AS VARCHAR) AS observation_code
    , CAST(observation_description AS VARCHAR) AS observation_description
    , CAST(observation_value AS VARCHAR) AS observation_value
    , CAST(observation_units AS VARCHAR) AS observation_units
    , CAST(observation_value_type AS VARCHAR) AS observation_value_type
FROM parsed

WITH src AS (

    SELECT
        NULLIF(TRIM("date_date"), '') AS d
        , NULLIF(TRIM("date_time"), '') AS t
        , NULLIF(LOWER(TRIM("patient")), '') AS patient_id
        , NULLIF(LOWER(TRIM("encounter")), '') AS encounter_id
        , NULLIF(LOWER(TRIM("category")), '') AS observation_category
        , NULLIF(TRIM("code_display"), '') AS code_display
        , NULLIF(TRIM("value"), '') AS observation_value
        , NULLIF(TRIM("units"), '') AS observation_units
        , NULLIF(LOWER(TRIM("type")), '') AS observation_value_type
    FROM {{ source('raw_d2', 'observations') }}

)

, parsed AS (

    SELECT
        CAST(try_strptime(d || ' ' || t, '%m/%d/%Y %H:%M:%S') AS TIMESTAMP) AS observation_datetime
        , patient_id
        , encounter_id
        , observation_category
        , CASE
            WHEN strpos(code_display, ' | ') > 0
                THEN TRIM(substr(code_display, 1, strpos(code_display, ' | ') - 1))
            ELSE code_display
        END AS observation_code
        , CASE
            WHEN strpos(code_display, ' | ') > 0
                THEN NULLIF(TRIM(substr(code_display, strpos(code_display, ' | ') + 3)), '')
            ELSE NULL
        END AS observation_description
        , observation_value
        , observation_units
        , observation_value_type
    FROM src

)

SELECT
    observation_datetime
    , CAST(observation_datetime AS DATE) AS observation_date
    , CAST(patient_id AS VARCHAR) AS patient_id

    , CAST(observation_value AS VARCHAR) AS observation_value

        , CASE

                    , '.0'
                )
            ELSE raw_value
        END AS observation_value

            WHEN converted_value IS NOT NULL AND raw_units = 'g' THEN 'kg'
            WHEN converted_value IS NOT NULL AND raw_units = 'm' THEN 'cm'
